notes.title: Bless Online Service Closure Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/338ca2e4c525a11d2ecc06274384b57a84a3ee74.jpg[/img]

To our loyal [i]Bless Online[/i] Community,

It has been a little over a year since Bless Online was launched on Steam as an early-access game here in the West. All of the teams here at Bless Online would like to express our deepest gratitude to our players and supporters. Unfortunately, after much deliberation and efforts from everyone here at Bless Online, with a heavy heart, we are sad to announce that the Steam online service for Bless Online will close on [b]September 9th, 2019 00:00[/b].

Starting after server maintenance on [b]June 10th, 2019[/b] and until [b]September 8th, 2019 23:59[/b], sales of all digital products within Steam will be disabled, prices of items in the in-game stores will drastically decrease, the entry limits to all Dungeons will be removed, and the Dungeon drop rates will be increased. Players will also see a 100% increase in Gathering/Mining EXP, Guild EXP, EXP gained from hunting, Dungeon Points, and Combat Points. Gathering, Mining, and Crafting speeds will be increased by 50%. 

Finally, we would like to stay connected to our players and supporters through our newsletter by sharing upcoming news and benefits regarding Neowiz games and its future projects. If you want to stay informed of upcoming news and announcements regarding Neowiz, you can subscribe to our newsletter from our [i]Bless Online[/i] [url=www.blessonline.net]official website[/url]

 [url=https://blessonline.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360024505013-Service-Termination-FAQ]
Service Closure FAQ[/url]


[b]Thank you.[/b]
Everyone here at [i]Bless Online[/i]

notes.title: March 27th Maintenance Cancellation/Patch Rollback Compensation
notes.content:
To all players,

We here at Bless Online would like to apologize on the cancellation and roll back of March 27th maintenance and update. 

Maintenance cancellation and Patch rollback was due to server instability and patch performance issues.

Once we have more detailed information, we will make a formal announcement of the changed schedule to the v.3.5.0.0 patch update through our communication channels. 

Source of the issues are being patched and thoroughly reviewed by our Bless Teams and will be announced along with the rescheduled patch update.

And to express our sincere apologies, we will be compensating our users for the inconveniences.

[h1]Qualification[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Users who have logged in to the game 12 hours prior and after of the initial maintenance extension (Premium, Non-Premium)
[*]Extension on Premium Membership (Applies to users with active membership during the maintenance duration)
[h1][u]Compensation is as follows[/u][/h1]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][b]User Type[/b][/th]
        [th][b]Contents[/b][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Non-Premium Member[/td]
        [td]100 Lumena[/td]
      [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Premium Member[/td]
        [td]100 Lumena + 240 minutes extension on Membership[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[/olist]

Once again, all of us at Bless Online apologize for the interruptions and any inconvenience it may have caused. We'd like to thank all of our supporters and players for their understandings.

Thank you.
Bless Online.

notes.title: Cancellation of March 27th Maintenance and Update Rollback
notes.content:
Dear Players,

All of us here at Bless Online would like to express our sincere apology to our users in regards to the unexpected maintenance extension and with a heavy heart announce that there will be a[u] [b]rollback of March 27th v.3.5.0.0 patch[/b][/u]

During our maintenance, we have encountered a [u]critical issue[/u] regarding our servers and all of our teams here at Bless Online are working around the clock to locate the source of the problem and have it resolve as soon as we can.

[b]Brief Summary of March 27th maintenance is as follows,[/b]
[olist]
[*]Regular maintenance has been cancelled and rollback of March 27th update is complete

[*]We have also sent [u]100 Lumena[/u] to our players to be used in purchasing Skill Reset Scrolls for our March 27th update. Since the update has been [u]cancelled[/u], the Lumena [b]can be used freely at the player's discretion.[/b]

[*][u]And for those affected by the incident, we will initiate our compensation   process[/u] and can expect compensation by March 29th 2019.
[/olist]

We will inform our users as soon as our team has new developing news in regarding today's issue along with updated release date for the v.3.5.0.0. patch.

Again, everyone here at Bless Online apologize for the unexpected issue and again, thank you for your understanding.

Bless Online

notes.title: [Update Preview] The Balance Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/61da12976c39f28c996d5c9a155cbbe417538135.jpg[/img]
Greetings Bless Online Community!

The long awaited class balance update will be coming to Bless Online on March 27th! 

The update will feature numerous changes requested by the community such as PvE/PVP balance changes, providing each class with a new 5th set of skills, as well as improve many basic features of Bless Online such as dismantling, dodge and skill chaining mechanics, and player inventory size.

Below is just a small preview of the new tactics added for each class for the upcoming update!
[i] *Please note that tactic names are subject to change and may differ in the actual update. [/i]

[/tr]

[td]Tactic specialized for survival[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]

[td]Tactic specialized for wide-area effects[/td]

A more detailed list of upcoming changes can be found in the March Producer’s Letter here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1794027541528582071 

We will continue to monitor your feedback on the balance update and make additional changes after the update if necessary.

notes.title: Known issues after the March 20th Urgent Maintenance
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have identified a bug with the Snowfield Buffalo Set when equipped by a Mascu character, it will show as the character is not equipped with the Set. 

We are currently in the process of fixing this bug and Mascu characters will be displayed normally after the fix is complete. 

We expect to resolve this issue by next patch update and will make sure to notify players once this is done.

Thank you for your understanding and again we apologize for the issue.


The Bless Online

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] The Upcoming Balance Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/765a16afb7901bd5e59708c99eabd29d43f5434e.jpg[/img]

Hello to the Bless Online community! It’s hard to believe it’s already March, isn’t it? In the last update in February, we introduced the new Urdaata War Fortress dungeon, along with some fun costumes and hats. Coming up next this month will be even more exciting things for Bless.

We know many of you have been asking for balance changes to PvP and PvE. We’ve been listening and gathering feedback from the community, and soon it will be time to implement the improvements. In addition to these changes, we will also be adding a new class skill set for each class.

[b] PvP/PvE Balance Changes [/b]

[i] [All Classes] [/i]

[list]
[*] [u]Dodge Skills[/u]
For all classes, we will be improving the normal dodge-type skills, so that they have priority and can be used even when a character is in the midst of using another skill. Guardians and Paladins will also be able to interrupt their dodge skills. The skills affected include:
[/list]

[table]
    [tr]
        [td]Guardian[/td]
        [td]Guardian's Faith[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Berserker[/td]
        [td]Dodge Move[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Ranger[/td]
        [td]Dodge Move[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Paladin[/td]
        [td]Endure[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Assassin[/td]
        [td]Shadow Charge[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Mage[/td]
        [td]Blink[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[list]
[*] [u]Skill Progression[/u]
We will be making modifications to skill progression and growth to make skill growth more rewarding. We felt previously that the effects gained from growing skills felt somewhat insignificant - now skill progression should feel better and more satisfying.

[*] [u]New 5th Tactic[/u]
A new 5th tactic will be added to expand the possible variety of combat experiences for each class. The Guardian’s new tactic, “Guardian of Darkness,” will be balanced between attack and defense. The Ranger will get the new “Survival Instinct” tactic, unsurprisingly focused around survival. The Paladin’s “Wide Area” tactic will contain skills meant to be used over large areas. The Assassin’s “Throw” tactic is centered around keeping long range attackers in check and survivability. The Berserker’s “Charge” tactic focuses on closing the gap, and the Mage’s “Fusion Element” tactic is a versatile set of skills that are best put to use supporting a party or raid group. Please keep in mind that the tactic names have not yet been finalized!

[*] [u]Skill Chaining[/u]
After the balance update, if a player misses during a skill chain, the chain will continue to increase regardless. Additionally, if a player uses a normal skill during a skill chain, the chain will no longer break.

[*] [u]Dismantling[/u]
After the update, the dismantling functionality will be improved so that multiples of an item can be dismantled at one time.

[*] [u]Expanded Inventory[/u]
We will be increasing the amount of inventory slots available for players’ convenience.
[/list]

[i] [Guardian] [/i]

[list]
[*] For the Guardian, we heard feedback and saw for ourselves that the class needed a damage buff. As such, we will be increasing the damage dealt by several of the Guardian’s skills. 
[/list]

[i] [Paladin] [/i]

[list]
[*] For the Paladin, we recognized that the healing from Sacrificial Plea greatly overshadowed the healing done by other healing skills, and players were relying too heavily on just Sacrificial Plea. To combat this issue, we will be reducing the healing amount and increasing the HP penalty of Sacrificial Plea, and increasing the healing amount of Beacon of Healing.
[/list]

[i] [Ranger] [/i]

[list]
[*] There will be several important changes made for the Ranger. First of all, we will be making it easier to smoothly sequence skills. Previously, there was a problem where skill sequencing could be difficult due to the player having insufficient Concentration. To help alleviate this issue, we will be reducing the Concentration consumption of certain skills and increasing the amount of Concentration gained from certain tactics.

[*] We will also be changing each tactic’s chain skills, so that each tactic is made up of skills that fit best with the tactic’s characteristics. One example of these changes is that we will be switching in some skills into the Swift Attack Tactic that are more suitable for the theme of “attack and retreat.”
[/list]

[i] [Mage] [/i]

[list]
[*] For this magic-wielding class, we will be modifying the mana recovery rate so that greater benefits are gained from class-appropriate armor. When a Mage equips all robe-type armor, their mana recovery rate will be higher than it was previously. In addition, if a Mage has non-robe type armor equipped, their mana recovery rate will be lower than it was before the changes.
[/list]

[i] [Assassin] [/i]

[list]
[*] We will be changing how the damage is distributed throughout chained skills. Previously, damage was distributed fairly evenly between the Chain Start Skill, the middle Chain Skill, and the last Chain Skill. After the balance changes, the expected damage value done by the last Chain Skill will be higher than the Chain Start Skill or the middle Chain Skill.

[*] We will also be raising the amount by which certain effects or benefits are increased (proportionally to Mark of Death) at the end of an Assassin’s chain skill. For an example, if before the balance change update an effect was “increase Malevolence by 2 proportionally to Mark of Death,” the Malevolence after the March update might be increased by 4 instead of 2.
[/list]

As you can see, there’s a lot to look forward to in March! We can’t wait to hear all of your feedback on the new changes once you’ve had a chance to test them out.

Until next time,
Woo-Young Jung
Executive Producer

notes.title: Daylight Saving Time Changes
notes.content:
Dear Players, 

Since the Daylight Saving Time will soon be applied, we’re planning to reflect the required time changes to the game. We are planning to update the game texts simultaneously for both servers. 

Please note that the times specified in game might still appear as PST(Pacific Standard Time) or CET(Central European Time) even before or after the DST(Daylight Saving Time) starts as it is applied differently for each region.

Time Zone converters are available online. Please use them at your own discretion.

We will update you the maintenance date once it is determined.

[h1]DST(Daylight Saving Time) changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] NA: March 10 at 2:00 am PST(Pacific Standard Time)
[*] EU: March 31 at 2:00 am CET(Central European Time)
[/list]

[h1]In-game Texts[/h1]
[list]
[*] Siege of Castra, Peninsular War, Capital War, Certanon Arena schedules will be updated to PDT(Pacific Daylight Saving Time) for the NA region and CET for the EU region during the scheduled maintenance.
[/list]

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Update Preview] Urdaata War Fortress
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/363a0918bb14d193de4e813e93991db2204b613f.jpg[/img]

Greetings to the Bless Online Community!

Coming up on February 20th, we will have an exciting new update for you all to enjoy!


[b]New Urdaata War Fortress Dungeon[/b]

Get ready to fight your way through the Urdaata War Fortress. This new level 50 dungeon has a group size of a maximum of 10 players, and can be entered once per week.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4fa7af33d1454d12053fc437762b4c6a4a31a06c.png[/img]

Those brave enough to enter will have to battle their way past a host of deadly bosses, including Corrupted Aelia, Ikichi, and Lava Golem Maglam. For their efforts, players can be rewarded with Rings and Necklaces with useful effects, Rare or Heroic Armor and items, Enhancement materials, and more. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/80868f27a3e26fd7415da8dbad2e6b30cacdeafc.png[/img]

If they vanquish the final boss, Karata, they can receive Rings, Legendary Weapons, Rare or Heroic Armor, Magic, Rare, or Heroic Spirits, or Figures.


[b]New Cosmetics[/b]

Along with the new dungeon, several new cosmetic items will be available, including the regal Winter Sky costume set for 2600 Lumena, and three new leopard print headband hat items for 400 Lumena each!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a135c135a17db14b1ab733a4505535c87d731864.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/baa3199d9b1c0b061581ee8bf26f33a2af5d9af2.png[/img]


[b]Future Updates[/b]

As we have been working to determine our update cadence and prepare new content and improvements for Bless, we saw that some of the community felt there has been a lull in our communications. Rest assured, more updates are in the pipeline and we are still working hard on improvements and updates for the game!

Additionally, look for a Producer’s Letter later next month; it will have some exciting details about the next update we have planned. We’ve been listening to your feedback and have some changes in the works that we think you’ll be excited about.

For now, you can focus on training for your face off against final boss Karata in the Urdaata War Fortress!

Cheers,
The Bless Team

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where the Santa Wyvern and Santa Raccoon pets wouldn’t be summoned.

[*]Fixed an issue where the skirt of a Pantera female character would be abnormally displayed when equipping the ground mount costume “Charging Drakaru” on a mount.
[*]Fixed an issue where the hair of Lupus / Pantera / Mascu characters would sometimes go through the helmet and top part of the costume when the Snowfield Buffalo Set is equipped.

[*]Fixed an issue where the effects wouldn’t work properly when equipping 7 parts of the the Partizan’s Successors set.
[*]Fixed an issue where the effect would appear before the actual motion when a female Pantera character uses the Challenge skill.

[*]Fixed an issue where in some areas, the player can unilaterally attack “Sak the Hobgoblin’s Friend”, which appears in Basel Gorge, without being attacked by it.
[*]Fixed an issue where the tooltip UI in non-targeting mode wouldn’t disappear when removing the mouse pointer.

[*]Fixed an issue that didn’t allow players to dismantle equipment continuously.

[/list]

[*] Hot Taming Event ended
[/olist]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/e35e4fa82fbeac2525fac293c95a7414db91b154.png[/img]

[*] Added Mount / Pet Anima items to the Special Currency Store, which can now be used by players Level 8 and over.
[*] Added NPC summoning items to the Special Currency Store.
- NPC summoning items can be summoned from the Market / Personal Chest / General Merchant / Blacksmith and can be either valid for one use or permanent.
[/olist]

[h1][Improved Functions][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Improved the UI where the Passive Effect was displayed.
- Emphasized the outline of the icon
- Added the cooldown time inside the icon (number is now displayed)
[*] Added a cancel button to the quest notification UI.
[*] Improved some German translations.
[*] Improved the companion upgrade, item enhancement, transcended enhancement, and enhancement succession visual effects. 
[*] Added a button that brings related menus from the character info into the life tab.
[/olist]

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where a user’s target’s pet disappears when a hostile target uses Stealth.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects of “Blue Fog” during the Rift of Space and Time flickered repeatedly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the portal inside a dungeon would be deactivated after resurrecting inside the dungeon if the raid party was killed in the next area after having defeated “Mahabali Statue” in the Patala Ruins raid dungeon.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented players from continuing with a quest since the explanation of the specific royal quest and the text shown in the dialogue with NPCs displayed different info.
[*] Fixed an issue where the message “You can't hold more items” or “You must free up some space in your inventory” would appear and the next quest couldn’t be accepted by the player despite them having enough space in their inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue where unselectable icons in the customization window were brightly displayed after a player used a gender change token and entered the customization window.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Market WIC window could not be closed when pressing the ESC key after having selected a text field inside the WIC.
[*] Fixed an issue where using a skill mid-air would force the character to land again.
[*] Fixed a bug where the door of the dungeon wouldn’t open if the dungeon’s special boss was defeated with reflective damage, thus preventing the player from completing it.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sealed Mark of the Relic Guardian’s Chest would keep receiving a regeneration effect from the Regeneration Magic Tower, making the player unable to obtain the Marks of Space and Time Chest which appears in the Rift of Space and Time.
[*] Fixed an issue that didn’t allow the player to continue with the Habicht quest.
[/olist]

notes.title: [Update Preview] Wise Ones' Mausoleum Dungeon (Elite)
notes.content:
[b]Wise One's Mausoleum Dungeon (Elite)[/b]

On January 9th, the new Wise One's Mausoleum (Elite) dungeon will be added to Bless. This level 50 dungeon has a recommended party number of 5, and an entrance limit of once per day. The entrance location for both Hieron and Union players can be found in the Wise One’s Ruins inside the Elemental Forest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6fec80050821523c1b2ed7be05c08b0946682f6d.png[/img]

Fight your way past the denizens of the mausoleum to do battle with final boss Liche Tiberius! A variety of rewards can be earned from the mid bosses and the final boss, including crafting materials, Rare Spirits, a legendary helmet, and more. 


[b]Basel Gorge Certificate of Valor Event[/b]

The first in-game event for 2019 will be taking place in Basel Gorge! Starting after maintenance is complete on January 9th, players will be rewarded with Certificates of Valor when they defeat monsters in Basel Gorge or when they complete Basel Gorge daily quests. Players can then use the Certificates of Valor to craft a variety of gift boxes. Gift boxes also have a chance to drop directly from defeated monsters in Basel Gorge. Gift boxes may contain buff effect foods, weapon skins, temporary flying mounts, or various enhancement materials!


[b]Sales[/b]

On January 9th, the Special Currency Shop will be getting an update with some new items, including Anima Random Boxes, Ruru Brother’s Magic Pocket (The resource dungeon turban item), and portable NPC summoning items called Popochita On-Demand Service (single use and permanent item versions for summoning the Market, Personal Chest Manager, General Merchant, and Blacksmith).

Nine new cosmetics will also be added to the Special Currency Shop, including the Snowfield Buffalo Set (pictured below), which includes the costume as well as the Charging Drakaru mount skin and the Walking Lollo pet skin.

The other six cosmetics are the hats for players to purchase and wear contained in the newly added “Hat” tab of the Special Currency Shop!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c9e60ea558b02f28e6691eaa0d050bdb6c90f7ef.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b4370c721b5948db6b02c2101e36ef100c978263.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a3616bbbbdde0f9a18c255114373159328897b10.png[/img]

2019 has only just begun, but there’s already a lot to look forward to!

Happy New Year,
The Bless Team

notes.title: December 19 - New Consolidated Servers Now Open and Compensation Notice
notes.content:
Greetings,
Server consolidation maintenance ended on 12/19 at 07:30 (PST) and the new servers have opened.
Thank you for your patience.

[h1][ New Consolidated Servers ][/h1]
Players may now verify their transferred character information by connecting to the new consolidated servers.

NA 
[list]
[*][b]Hilan / Kairos[/b] have been merged to form the new server [b][NA] Perisos.[/b]
[/list]
EU
[list]
[*] [b]Bacillas / Iriaphos[/b] have been merged to form the new server [b][EU] Harman.[/b]
[/list]

[h1][ Server Consolidation Compensation ][/h1]
[list]
[*]As compensation for the server consolidation maintenance, if a Premium Membership Buff was used during maintenance, it will be extended by 24 hours.
[*][b]However, please be aware that only those who connect to the game within 7 days, beginning from after the 12/19 maintenance ends till 12/26 09:30 PST, will receive the extension. [/b]The extension will not be delivered to the mailbox but instead will be extended automatically.
[*]As a token of our thanks to those who waited during server consolidation, we plan to deliver [b]500 Lumena to players’ account inboxes.[/b] The 500 Lumena will be delivered gradually in waves starting after maintenance ends through 12/20 PST.
[*][b]The High Praetor/Protector Marshall guild that won the last Capital War will lose their standing after the server consolidation. As compensation, we are giving the guild 20,000 Reign Points.[/b]
[/list]

[h1][ Recovery of Paid Items ][/h1]
Items purchased from the Special Currency Shop
[list]
[*]Items from the costume/mount costume/pet costume/Extend Function categories of the Special Currency Shop, if owned by a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters on the consolidated servers, have been [b]collected and converted into Lumena (matching the purchase price), and then combined and given to the player’s highest level character.[/b]
[/list]

Inventory Slot Expansion and Character Slot Expansion Item
[list]
[*]Unused Inventory Slot Expansion and Character Slot Expansion items that are in the inventory or storage have been [b]collected and converted into Lumena (matching the purchase price), and then combined and given to the player’s highest level character.[/b]
[/list]

Founder’s Pack/Lumena Pack/Premium Membership 
[list]
[*]If characters that have any of the above items are deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters, the items (excluding Premium Membership Buffs and Lumena; see the bullet point below for more info) will be collected and [b]delivered as a package to the player’s account inbox during server consolidation maintenance.[/b]
[*]Since Premium Membership Buffs are applied account-wide, there is no need to recover them since they already apply to the player’s characters. Lumena is collected and recovered through a different method and is therefore excluded from the packages delivered to the player’s inbox.
[*]The deliveries will be made sequentially during server consolidation maintenance and will continue to be processed even after maintenance has finished. Thank you for your understanding.
[/list]

[h1][ Dominion Contract and Capital War on the New Server ][/h1]
[list]
[*]The first Dominion Contract will be conducted on the new consolidated server on Saturday, December 29. The guild that succeeds in the Dominion Contract with the most points will be appointed the first High Praetor or Protector Marshall. The appointed High Praetor or Protector Marshall guild will then be joining the Capital War that begins on Saturday, January 5 as the Defense Alliance. Afterwards, it will be the same as before with the High Praetor or Protector Marshall decided according to the results of the Defense/Attack Alliance in the Capital War.  
[/list]

[h1]Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]According to the character preservation standards, some characters on servers to be consolidated may be deactivated after the opening of the new consolidated server.
[*]If a player would like to reactivate a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or character limit after server consolidation, then please contact our Customer Support. 
   [b]※ Please decide carefully as faction changes can be made through our Customer Support only ONCE.  [/b]
[*]If by any chance a guild leader character gets deactivated after the server consolidation maintenance, the guild will also be deactivated. Any guild member can contact Customer Support to request that the guild be reactivated by making one of the current guild members the guild leader. The criteria for selecting the new guild leader is as follows: 
   ※ First priority - the character with the higher guild ranking 
   ※ Second priority - the character who joined the guild first
   ※ Third priority - the character that has logged in most recently within the last two weeks
   [b]※ If a guild has only one member (and that member is the guild leader and is deactivated), the guild will be deactivated and will not be recovered even if the guild leader character is restored. In order to prevent this, make sure to add at least one new member to any single person guilds and appoint the new member as a vice guild leader before the server consolidation maintenance takes place.[/b]
[*][b] If a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or character limit was a guild member, then the character will also be removed from the guild members list. [/b]
[*]Overlapping character names or guild names can be changed beginning December 19, after the server consolidation maintenance.
   - Guild names that were temporarily changed due to overlapping may be changed by the guild leader character upon login.
[*]Character names on a player’s friends list may be changed or deleted after server consolidation. Please double check when sending mail or gifts.
[*]After server consolidation, players with battle ranks (Command Class) will maintain the ranks assigned from previous servers until the next evaluation. 
  - As ranks were recalculated during server maintenance, please be advised that those who applied for a battle rank promotion evaluation before server consolidation may not receive a separate system notification even if their rank promotion application failed. [/list]

Please refer to the following link for detailed information regarding the Server Consolidation Transfer Policy.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1699443067727707319

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Rift of Time and Space Seasons
notes.content:
Some of you have been noticing recent changes to the Rift of Space and Time. This is due to a new season! Each season lasts 2 weeks before changing to the next season in the rotation. Previously, the RoST was in Season 4. At the start of this week, it rotated, and is now in Season 1. You can read the details of each season’s mechanics below.

[b]Season 1 (current season)[/b]
- Increased movement speed and HP for mobs.
- A Mark of Space and Time sealed box is located in random areas of the battle zone. After attacking this box, the player can obtain a Mark of Space and Time.

[b]Season [/b]2
- Increased Attack Power for each mob that appears in specific rounds in each stage.
- When attacking the crystals that appear in certain areas of the stage, the party members' Attack Power will increase and the mobs’ Attack Power will return to normal.

[b]Season 3[/b]
- A sealed magic totem will appear in a particular round of each stage. After this magic totem appears, a mob that only attacks relics from both sides will be summoned.
- If the magic totem is destroyed within the time limit, a summoning stone item usable by allies will be dropped.
- By using the summoning stone item, a Seal Protect Summoner will summon allies, who will attack the surrounding mobs.
- If the magic totem cannot be destroyed within the time limit, it will use a powerful skill within a 50m range.

[b]Season 4 (previous season)[/b]
- At the start of the first round of each stage, the party members will be a given a Dimensional Chaos effect.
- When this Dimensional Chaos effect wears off, it changes to a Dimensional Collapse effect, causing the party members to die.
- The Dimensional Chaos effect duration can be refreshed by moving to a Time Warp Area, which appears in a random location during each stage.
- The Time Warp Area disappears as soon as it’s stepped on and it appears again in another random location.
- The party members that step on a Time Warp Area will obtain an increased Damage effect.

We also heard your reports of the bug with the spawned boxes in Season 1 where the HP and rewards were not appearing as they should. This issue will be fixed with the maintenance planned for 12/12.

notes.title: [Update Preview] Rift of Time and Space Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6dea2df140867b5aa6a1afb59a5b83358353132d.jpg[/img]
Next week, on December 5th, we will be adding some never-before-seen content to Bless Online on Steam!

[b]Rift of Time and Space[/b]

After temporarily closing on November 7th, the Rift of Time and Space will be reopening with a brand new third stage! This expansion will take RoTS to a total of 30 rounds (previously 20), add a new area, and will also see the addition of new stage rewards: bracelet items that give additional effects to the wearer!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/61d806c14cc68da54266da058791bdd2b18762e6.png[/img]

This new third stage has never been released before in any region, so Bless players on Steam will be the first to try it out! We can’t wait to hear what you think.


[b]New Holiday Costume[/b]

In the spirit of the holiday season, a new festive costume will be added to the Lumena Shop! The Snowflake Winter Festival Costume can be purchased for 2600 Lumena.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6f18a0024957fcecae50391316a50bed9ce32a41.jpg[/img]

You are sure to bring holiday cheer to your fellow players with this new costume!


[b]Korean Region IP Unlocked + Language Added[/b]

With this update, the Korean region will be unlocked, and players from that region will be able to enjoy playing Bless on Steam! Korean language support will also be added at this time. We are thrilled to be able to support our Korean players in this way following the discontinuation of the KR Bless Online service, and we look forward to them joining Bless Online on Steam.


[b]Holiday In-Game Events[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/09f210a0104aa2fe84b009d634147960832a584a.jpg[/img]

This December, starting on December 1st and running through December 31st, we will be holding a Festive December Login Event! During this time period, players will be able to get a variety of great rewards, including the Ruru Brother’s Magic Pocket item that allows players to summon the Rand Brother Turban and access the special gathering and mining area within it. 
 
To get rewards, all players have to do is log in to Bless, click on “Collect Daily Rewards” in the Check Attendance window, and get the rewards on the character of their choice!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6e625642aef731467311e0c106c5072b0b768f59.jpg[/img] 

In addition to this login event, starting on December 5th after the update maintenance, the Winter Festival Event will be taking place in game! There are three interconnected quests for this festival event, and players can complete each of them once per day. During these quests, players will have to make sure the festival celebration goes off without a hitch by collecting the Light of the World Tree, helping citizens with their wishes, and more!
 
Each quest comes with a special reward, including a temporary flying mount, firecrackers, and consumable items.


Wishing you a happy holiday season,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] Looking Ahead to the Mystic
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/765a16afb7901bd5e59708c99eabd29d43f5434e.jpg[/img]

Hello to the Bless Online community!

Since launch, we have been adding updates in quick succession to bring you the exciting content you want to see in Bless. Right after launch, we added the huge level 50 expansion, followed by a new dungeon! Coming up on December 5th, you will get to see Rift of Space and Time re-open with a brand new stage!

With the year drawing to a close, however, we wanted to give you a look a little further into the future - into the development plans for the first half of next year. We have a lot in the works, but as we know you are all most excited to hear about the new Mystic class, we wanted to give you an update!

The next new class, the Mystic, is currently in development, and is slated to be added to Bless Online on Steam in the first half of 2019. As we want to ensure a balanced, enjoyable experience with the Mystic and will put in all the work necessary to achieve that, we don’t yet have an exact release date yet. We will also ensure that all existing classes are properly balanced for the addition of the Mystic.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/423d1a331530f90e494b697c2cc4f990adf213fc.jpg[/img]

The Mystic will be a healer class - another option besides the Paladin for those who want to support their fellow players by keeping them alive. The Mystic’s main function will be healing and support, though they will also have skills that allow them to attack and damage enemies.

 Many of the Mystic’s skills will be focused around HoT (Heal over Time) and DoT (Damage over Time) effects that will allow them to continuously damage enemies and help allies. Just like the other classes in Bless, the Mystic will have a variety of skills to choose from, allowing players to customize how they want to play. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/2ce52ac4f99835dc13dbd75cf87e778d90c64e53.jpg[/img]

Besides the Mystic, there are many other things to look forward to in the coming year, including new dungeons, new skills, and more - even new Realm vs Realm content!

This new RvR content will introduce PvPvE to Bless Online, as a new third power will appear and threaten both Hieron and Union. This third force, which was previously gathering its power quietly in the uncharted territories, will appear and invade the Union and Hieron mainland.

However, we don’t want to spoil everything yet! You can look forward to more updates about next year’s content down the road. Remember to check back on Friday as well to read the Update Preview for the December 5th update!

Always at your service,
Woo-Young Jung

notes.title: December 19 Server Merger Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings!

We will be consolidating our servers on December 19th (PST).

The details are as follows. 

[h1][Server Consolidation Schedule and Guide] [/h1]
[olist]
[*]Server Consolidation Schedule: December 19th, 2018 (PST) * The maintenance time will be announced at a later date
[*] Who will be affected?
[/olist]
Characters that were created before the expected maintenance on December 19th will be transferred to the new consolidated servers. Enjoy Bless in a new environment!
 
- NA Region:
Hilan / Kairos will be merged to form the new server [NA] Perisos.
 
- EU Region
Bacillas / Iriaphos will be merged to form the new server [EU] Harman.
 
[h1][Transference of Character Information][/h1]
 
All character information will be transferred securely. However, if there are any faction clashes (if a player has characters from both the Hieron or Union faction) or if there are insufficient character slots for the amount of characters possessed, then some characters may be deactivated according to the priority guidelines below. 

[b]If there is no discrepancy between the characters’ factions and there are enough slots for all characters on an account, then rest assured that all character information will be transferred securely. [/b]
 
[olist]
[*] [b]What if I have characters from different factions?[/b]
As the Bless world is based on the conflicting Hieron and Union factions, players cannot create characters of both the Hieron and Union faction on the same server.

Therefore, if an account has both Hieron and Union characters on servers that will be consolidated, only one faction’s characters will be transferred and the other will be deactivated. The process for determining which faction’s characters will remain and which will be deactivated will be based on the following character preservation priority standards. The opposing faction’s characters will automatically be deactivated. 

(Deactivation does not mean that your character information will be deleted. Although the character will not be shown on the character selection window, Neowiz will continue to store the character’s information. If the player would like to have their other faction’s character information preserved, and it happens to be eligible for restoration under Neowiz’s policy, then the player may request the reactivation of the inactive faction’s character information and deactivate the opposite faction’s character.)
 
- Priority Guidelines for when a player has characters of opposing factions:

First Priority: Guild leader characters
Second Priority: High level characters
Third Priority: Most recently used character

If an account has a character that is a guild leader, we will prioritize preserving characters that are in the same faction as the guild leader character. If there is no guild leader character, the next priority will be high level characters, and lastly, the most recently played character. The faction to be preserved will be decided using the above standards.

[i]*Guild leaders are prioritized because a guild’s information will also be deleted if its guild leader is deleted, thereby affecting not only the guild leader but all guild members. [/i]
 
[*] [b]What if I have more characters than character slots?[/b]
A total of 10 slots are available, including 4 free slots and 6 paid slots.
If an account has more characters than character slots, the characters to be transferred will be determined based on the below character preservation priority standard and the amount of character slots a player has. 
 
First Priority: Guild leaders characters
Second Priority: High level characters
Third Priority: Most recently used character
 
For example, if a player did not purchase extra character slots on the servers to be consolidated, then only a max of 4 character slots will be available. As a result, only 4 characters will be transferred according to the above character preservation standard. All other characters aside from the 4 will be deactivated. (There is no problem if you have less characters than the amount of slots owned.)
 
[*] [b]What if someone has the same character name?[/b]
 
If another character has the same character name within the servers to be consolidated, then your character name will be changed temporarily. 
 
[b]First Priority: [/b]Characters which were created before this Server Consolidation Announcement, and which were used to play the game between the announcement period and the actual server consolidation maintenance date.

If the other character with the same name did not connect to the game during the period between the announcement period and the actual server consolidation maintenance date, then the character name will be maintained. 
If the other character with the same name did connect to the game during the period between the announcement and the actual server consolidation maintenance date, then the player’s character name will be changed temporarily. Once connected to the new consolidated server, the player will be required to rename their character in order to proceed.

[b]Second Priority:[/b] Characters created after this Server Consolidation Announcement.

Between a character created before this announcement and one created after, the name of the one created before will be maintained if their character names overlap.
The character will be given a temporary name (original name + number), and ONE chance to change the character name upon connecting to the server after consolidation. 
Renaming characters on the new server will be conducted on a first-come first-serve basis. Players will need to act quickly in order to get their desired name. 
Players will not be able to connect to the game if overlapping names are not changed after server consolidation.

[*] [b]What if another guild has the same guild name?[/b]
If two guilds have the same name, the following priority naming standard will be applied.

First Priority: The name of the higher level guild will be preserved.
Second Priority: If the guild levels are the same, the guild that was created earlier will have their name preserved.
Third Priority: If both of the standards above are not applicable, then temporary names in the format of “Guild Name + Number” will be assigned. 
[i] ※ Guilds that were give temporary guild names can be changed once the guild leader character connects to the game. [/i]
 
[*][b] Gold[/b]
As gold is bound to the server, all gold from servers to be consolidated will be combined and made usable on the new server. In other words, if a player has 1 Gold on server A, and 2 Gold on server B, then the player will now have 3 Gold on the new server. 
 
[*] [b]Using the Market[/b]
As the market system of registering and purchasing items is account based, players can continue to register and purchase items from the marketplace regardless of character name changes. 
[/olist]

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Transference Information[/th]
	[th]Transference Standard[/th]
	[th]Priority Standards and Details[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]1. Preservation Standard according to Character’s Faction[/td]
	[td]Characters on the servers to be consolidated are all from the same faction[/td]
	[td]* All characters of the same faction will be combined in the new server. 
(However, the amount of characters transferred will differ depending on the amount of character slots available. Refer to section 2 of Transference Information).
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]1. Preservation Standard according to Character’s Faction[/td]
	[td]Characters on the servers to be consolidated are members of different factions [/td]
	[td]*If a player has characters from both factions on servers to be consolidated, then the characters and faction to be preserved will be determined according to the below Priority Standards. 
First Priority: Guild leader characters
Second Priority: High level characters
Third Priority: Most recently used character
(However, the amount of characters transferred will differ depending on the amount of character slots available. Refer to section 2 of Transference Information).
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]2. Character Transference Standard according to the amount of character slots owned[/td]
	[td]Total amount of characters owned do not exceed the amount of character slots owned. 
[/td]
	[td]*All characters will be transferred to the new server according to the amount of character slots owned. 
*The amount of characters transferred will depend on how many character slots were purchased (if any). [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]2. Character Transference Standard according to the amount of character slots owned[/td]
	[td]Total amount of characters owned exceeds the amount of character slots owned[/td]
	[td]* The amount of purchased character slots on servers to be consolidated will be combined and totaled. A max of 6 purchased character slots will be applied to the new server, but if the total amount of purchased character slots exceeds 6, the exceeding amount 
will be converted to Lumena that will be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server. 
(Depending on the standards, character slots belonging to a character in a deactivated faction will be either transferred to the active faction, or the exceeding amount will be transferred and given to the character with the highest level in the active faction).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]3. Name Preservation Standard for when two characters have the same name[/td]
	[td]No other character has the same name[/td]
	[td]Character name is preserved.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]3. Name Preservation Standard for when two characters have the same name[/td]
	[td]Two characters have the same name[/td]
	[td]* The character will be given a temporary character name according to the following Preservation Priority Standard. 
* Temporary character names must be changed upon connecting to the new server before you may begin the name.
First Priority: Characters which were created before this Server Consolidation Announcement, and which were used to play the game between the announcement date and the actual server consolidation maintenance date.
Second Priority: Characters created after this Server Consolidation Announcement.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]4. Name Preservation Standard for when two guilds have the same name[/td]
	[td]No other guild has the same name[/td]
	[td]Guild name is preserved.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]4. Name Preservation Standard for when two guilds have the same name[/td]
	[td]Two guilds share the same guild name[/td]
	[td]*Guilds with overlapping names that are not resolved under First Priority or Second Priority will have temporary names in the format of “Guild Name + Number” assigned. 
*Temporary guild names can be changed once the guild leader character connects to the game.
First Priority: The name of the higher level guild will be preserved.
Second Priority: The name of the guild that has been around longer will be preserved.
 If a guild that was created after this Server Consolidation Announcement shares the same name as one created before, it will be given a temporary name. 
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]5. Gold[/td]
	[td]-[/td]
	[td]
All gold from servers to be consolidated will be combined and made usable on the new server (Gold from the deactivated faction will also be included).
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]6. Using the Market[/td]
	[td]-[/td]
	[td]As the market system of registering and purchasing items is account based, players can use a different character on the same account to retrieve items put on the market before server consolidation.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
 
[h1][Transference and Recovery of Purchased Items][/h1]
 
[b]A) Purchased Character Slots[/b]
The amount of purchased character slots on all applicable servers will be totaled and combined.
 
Case 1: If there is only 1 purchased character slot on the applicable servers, the player will now have a total of 5 character slots (4 free + 1 purchased) available for use on the new server.
 
Case 2: If the total amount of purchased character slots exceeds 6, the exceeding amount will be converted to Lumena. The Lumena will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.  
 
Case 3: If the purchased character slot(s) is associated with a faction that has been deactivated in accordance with the above character preservation priority standards, then the purchased slot(s) will automatically be transferred to the remaining active faction. However, if the total amount of purchased character slots exceeds 6, the exceeding amount will be converted to Lumena. The Lumena will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.    
 
[b]B) Purchased Inventory Slots[/b]
A character’s active inventory slots will be transferred as is. However, the expanded inventory of a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters will be converted to Lumena. The Lumena will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.
 
[b]C) Lumena[/b]
All of a character’s Lumena will be transferred. However, the Lumena possessed by a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters will be collected and given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.  
 
[b]D) Founder’s Pack and Premium Membership Items[/b]
If characters with a Founder’s Pack or Premium Membership items are deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters, the concerning items (excluding Premium Membership Buffs and Lumena) will be collected and delivered to the player’s account inbox during server consolidation maintenance. 

(As Premium Membership Buffs are applied account-wide they are not eligible for recovery. Lumena will be collected and recovered through a different method and is therefore excluded from the packages that will be delivered to the player’s inbox.)

(If any of the deactivated characters have a looting pet or inventory expansion ticket which was obtained from a DLC, these items will not be provided again via the account inbox but will be compensated for at their current Special Currency Store Lumena price.
 
[b]E) Lumena Pack Items[/b]
Lumena Packs that were purchased but kept as items in the inventory (Lumena that has not yet been applied to a character) of characters that are deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters will be collected and delivered to the player’s account inbox during server consolidation maintenance. 
 
[b]F) Special Currency Shop[/b]
Items from the costume/ mount costume/ pet costume/ Extend Function categories of the Special Currency Shop, if owned by a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters, will be collected and converted into Lumena (matching the purchase price), and will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.

Items that are not from the costume / mount costume / pet costume / Extend Function categories are considered consumables or items with expiration dates/times and will not be recovered or compensated. 

[table]

	[th]Transference Standard[/th]
	[th]Priority Standards and Details[/th]
[/tr]

	[td]They will be totaled and combined.[/td]

[/tr]

[/td]
	[td]Inventory slots currently activated on each character will be transferred as is.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]B) Purchased Inventory Slots[/td]
	[td]The deactivated character has purchased inventory slots[/td]
	[td]Exceeding slots will be converted to Lumena and given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server. 
Inventory slots that were received as quest rewards will not be converted to Lumena.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]C) Lumena[/td]
	[td]If there are no deactivated characters [/td]
	[td]All of a character’s Lumena information will be transferred as is.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]C) Lumena[/td]
	[td]Some characters are deactivated [/td]
	[td]The Lumena owned by a deactivated character will be collected and added to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]D) Lumena Packs[/td]
	[td]The character that owns these items is active[/td]
	[td]Item information will be transferred as is.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]D) Lumena Packs[/td]
	[td]The character that has unused Lumena Packs in their inventory or mailbox has been deactivated[/td]
	[td]If the items are owned by a deactivated character, they will be collected and re-sent to the player’s account inbox.
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]E) Founder's Pack[/td]
	[td]The character that owns these items is active[/td]
	[td]Item information will be transferred as is.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]E) Founder's Pack[/td]
	[td]The character that has unused Founder’s Pack items in their inventory or mailbox has been deactivated[/td]
	[td]If the items are owned by a deactivated character, they will be collected and re-sent to the player’s account inbox (this package will exclude Lumena and Premium buffs, as Lumena will be recovered in a different way, and Premium Buffs are applied account-wide and not eligible for recovery).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]F) Premium Membership[/td]
	[td]The character that owns these items is active[/td]
	[td]Item information will be transferred as is.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]F) Premium Membership[/td]
	[td]The character that owns these items has been deactivated [/td]
	[td]As Premium Buffs are applied account wide, they don’t need to be transferred between characters. Premium Memberships will be collected and redelivered to the player’s account inbox.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]G) Items Purchased from the Special Currency Shop[/td]
	[td]The character that owns these items is active[/td]
	[td]Item information will be transferred as is.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]G) Items Purchased from the Special Currency Shop[/td]
	[td]The character that has these items in their inventory has been deactivated[/td]
	[td]Special Currency Shop items from the costume / mount costume / pet costume / Extend Function categories will be collected and converted to Lumena that will be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server
(All items that are considered consumables or with expiration dates will not be recovered or compensated)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h1][Server Merge Notice: Rift of Space and Time Ranking][/h1]
 
* All Rift of Space and Time rankings will be reset after the server merge. However, the entrance limit will not be reset and the Rift of Space and Time will continue after the server merge. Please keep this in mind when joining the Rift of Space and Time after the weekly ranking is reset and before the server merge maintenance.
 
[h1][Server Merge Notice: Capital War and Dominion Contract][/h1]
 
Since Capital War and Dominion Contract will start anew after the servers are merged, the previous servers’ Lord, Viceroy, Protector Marshall, and High Praetor will be reset. The High Praetor / Protector Marshall guild that was victorious in the last Capital War will lose its status after the server merge and will receive compensation later on. Please refer to the [Capital War and Dominion Contract Schedule Change Announcement] for more information.

- [b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] According to the above character preservation standards, some characters on servers to be consolidated may be deactivated after the opening of the new consolidated server.
[*] If a player would like to reactivate a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters after server consolidation, then please contact our Customer Support. 
[i]※ Please decide carefully as faction changes can be made through our Customer Support only ONCE. [/i]
[*] If by any chance a guild leader character gets deactivated after the server consolidation maintenance, the guild will also be deactivated. Any guild member can contact Customer Support to request that the guild be reactivated by making one of the current guild members the guild leader. The criteria for selecting the new guild leader is as follows: 
※ First priority - the character with the higher guild ranking 
※ Second priority - the character who joined the guild first
※ Third priority - the character that has logged in most recently within the last two weeks.
※ If a guild has only one member (and that member is the guild leader and is deactivated), the guild will be deactivated and will not be recovered even if the guild leader character is restored. In order to prevent this, make sure to add at least one new member to any single person guilds and appoint the new member as a vice guild leader before the server consolidation maintenance takes place.
[*] Character names on a player’s friends list may be changed or deleted after server consolidation. Please double check when sending mail or gifts.
[*] Overlapping character names or guild names can be changed beginning December 19th, after the server consolidation maintenance. 
[*] If a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters was a guild member, then the character will also be removed from the guild members list. 
[/list]

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Hotfix Update: Exploit Fixes, Reparations, and Clarifications
notes.content:
After the update, we applied a hotfix Wednesday (3.0.0.1) to address a few issues that arose, and we want to make sure the community is aware of the steps we took! Further actions to resolve the exploit were taken on Thursday.

In 3.0.0.1, most importantly, we fixed the exploit introduced in 3.0.0.0 through which players were able to purchase green items from the NPC vendors and dismantle them for enhancement materials (Pieces of Ymir’s Skin). The probability of obtaining materials when dismantling Magic grade items purchased through NPC vendors has since been reduced to negate the exploit.

We also fixed the issue where players could run Zeeto’s Laboratory more than once per day. No more living in Zeeto’s lab, folks, sorry! 

On Thursday, we took actions to resolve any unfair advantages gained by players due to the exploit that was hotfixed in 3.0.0.1.

[b]Actions:[/b]

[olist]

[*]All players who abused this bug had their items removed.
[*]If the items were unable to be removed, they had their market access taken away, and have been sent an in-game mail with instructions on how to remove their market restrictions.
[*]Players must either collect the required items so we can remove them from their account, or pay an approximate gold value for the items they acquired through this exploit. Users who are unable to return the proper number of items, or pay for the items will be given the option to have their upgraded items removed from their characters in order to regain access to the market.

[/olist]

We also wanted to clarify some points of the patch notes regarding the new level 50 dungeon (Zeeto’s Laboratory) that may have led to confusion among players.

In the patch notes, due to the wording, some players thought that only level 50 players could now enter Siege of Castra, Arenas, and Peninsular War. However, the entrance requirement level for these have not changed; upon entering these areas, the player’s character will be scaled up to level 50 (rather than level 45, as was the case previously) for the duration of the instance. We have adjusted the patch notes now as well to better reflect this meaning.

We hope this helps clarify any confusion, and we will continue to update you on future changes!

Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Changes in friend list after the 11/7 update
notes.content:
Hello, players

Bless Online's friends list will be improved on November 7th (Wednesday) as specified below.

Before the change, players would be added to another player's friend list without the other party having to accept the friend request. Now it has been changed so that the other party must accept the friend request to be added on each other's friend list.

Players' existing friend lists will be reset due to this update.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Thank you,
The Bless Team


UPDATE:
Only the friend list of players who haven’t added each other will be reset. (e.g.: If two players add each other, both players’ friend list will remain as is. However, if a player has added another player unilaterally, the latter will be deleted from the former’s friend list).

notes.title: [Update Preview] The Ruins of Shaqqara
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8c07206114a2c3edf69335124511a53207dc41fa.jpg[/img]

Greetings to the Bless Online community!

Official launch seems like only yesterday, but we’re already moving on towards our next big update on November 7th! We wanted to give you a look at the upcoming update that will contain not only a level cap increase to 50, but a new raid, gear, quests, and more!


[b]Level 50 Increase[/b]

Anyone who already has characters at the former level cap of 45 will be extra excited about the new level 50 cap! They, along with everyone else who has a bit further to go, will be able to continue growing their characters through new areas, story quests, and hunt quests. As the level cap will be increased, all characters will need to be at level 50 to participate in Royal Quests, which will appear randomly each day. 

Union players will continue their story by journeying to request help from the Pantera King, while Hieron players will have to forge their way to meet with Great Chieftain Chinuwa in Lupuscana. 

The new areas added include the Burning Desert, a sweltering and unforgiving wasteland rife with monstrous creatures, and Shaqqara, a mysterious zone filled with ancient ruins.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ef2633f9d098731dae8bc2d0505be0ee6c8ce096.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8dda453580b1cc75fa2b8fb945369de9f1ad338c.jpg[/img]


[b]New Dungeon - Zeeto’s Laboratory (Normal)[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/36b285e6f1cbf842f7e3811173c08aff8af8ab68.png[/img]

Zeeto’s Laboratory is a level 50 dungeon that players can enter once per day (again with a recommended group number of five). Players can enter Zeeto’s Laboratory in the Forbidden Area of the Polluted Forest. Inside, players will track down Zeeto himself and uncover the secret behind the underground laboratory!

Players will not be able to proceed through the dungeon unchallenged, as standing in their way will be mid-level bosses Zeedraco, Elem, Chikeekee, and Cimon! The final boss duo consists of Zeetatan and Zeeto. Players will be able to potentially get Spirit Harvesting Skills (1 Hour), Rare grade armor from the Aspiring weapon series, Hero grade armor from the Corrupted series, armorsmithing materials for the Corrupted series and Aspiring series, and crafting materials for the Legendary Mount Zeetatan.


Of course, besides all of this awesome new content, you’ll also be able to look forward to quality of life improvements, bug fixes, and more in game events for November! So… Who is going to be the first to level 50?

Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Item Enhancement Changes in the 11/7 Update
notes.content:
In addition to all the new content being added in the update on November 7th, there will also be some adjustments made to item Enhancement. To best prepare you all for the upcoming changes, we have shared the details of the changes below.

Our goal with these changes is to make it easier for player to navigate the Enhancement system and know where to use the Enhancement items that they obtain, thereby making the Enhancement process more streamlined and intuitive.

[b]Changes[/b]

[olist]


[*]Condensed Magic Stone will no longer be used as an Enhancement material, and instead will be used only as a Crafting material. Ymir's Horn and Piece of Ymir's Skin will replace Condensed Magic Stone as Enhancement materials. 

[*]All existing Enhancement materials currently in game used to enhance levels 1-10 or level 11+ can now be used for all Enhancement levels (1-15+), including pieces acquired through disassembling.
[list]
[*]The amount used for Enhancement will vary from material to material.
[*]Unlike before, the type of Enhancement materials used will be available in three different grades and the success probability differs between them.
[*]For example, the probability of success will be higher when using Sturdy Skin of Ymir than when using Piece of Ymir’s Skin to enhance weapons and equipment.

[/list]

[*]Items excluded from the current list of Enhancement materials are as follows:
[list]
[*]The Condensed Magic Stone, which used to be a main Enhancement material, will no longer be used for Enhancements. Advanced Enhancement materials will be used just as before during Crafting.
[*] Players no longer need Sword Body of Flogas / Contorted Wings of the Beyond / Contorted Horn of the Beyond / Contorted Nail of the Beyond to prevent a decrease in Enhancement level for those items. Instead, general Impurity Removers have replaced these specific items, and can be used on any of the equipment. These Impurity Removers can be acquired through disassembling any of the items listed above.
[*]The current Kindle of Urgand can be used for Transcendent Enhancements.

notes.title: Bless Online Releases on Steam Today
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8a4b797bc3448e36e6c8c5e965892649d4f8bb01.jpg[/img]

Hello, Bless players!

The day is finally here: Bless Online is officially released on Steam! As the game is leaving Early Access, Founder’s Packs are no longer available for purchase. However, to commemorate launch, we have several new DLC packs for you! Inside the Novice, Warlord, and Legendary Warlord Packs you will find incredible items to help you embark on your journey through the newly released Bless! You can read more about the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1691557329723628771] here.	[/url] Please also note that the DLC packs are character bound, and can't be restored or moved to other characters once the packs are accepted from the account inbox.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a791426ac005cbb1a9afba1d54e8a22c2dd96de9.jpg[/img]

We are extremely excited to welcome you all to Bless on Steam. Whether you are a new player just joining at the F2P launch, or a veteran player and founding member who has been with us from the beginning, we believe you’ll enjoy everything the game has to offer. In addition to all new German localization, we’ve made quite a few bug fixes and improvements since the last update, which you can read about in the patch notes, and we are already planning our next update for November, which will include raising the level cap and new content to go with it. 

Players who showed their support for Bless during Early Access will be receiving bonus gifts as a gesture of our appreciation, and you can read about exactly what rewards are in store [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1691557329723651659] here.	[/url] We will also be including the Steam names of the players who bought the Collector’s Edition during Early Access in the game credits!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/1257e2375919efb3158b8cd5a315c64f258e78bf.jpg[/img]

As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback and suggestions. Though Bless is leaving Early Access today, that doesn’t mean we’re going to stop listening to what you all have to say and constantly making adjustments and improvements to the game.

We look forward to seeing you out there in the world of Bless!

Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Founder Rewards at Launch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/cf3fd522171a051fa07cdac036e5f86cfe84268f.jpg[/img]
As mentioned previously, in thanks for all the support given to Bless during Early Access, we are providing ALL players who purchased the game during EA with some special gifts. Every one of these players will be receiving an exclusive costume skin only for Founders. Those who made purchases of the game at higher tiers will get even more bonus rewards, including pet and mount skins! You can refer to the chart below, which outlines the specifics. Players will be able to find these items in their account inbox today.

[table]
[tr]
[th]REWARD TIER[/th]
[th]REWARD ITEMS[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Base Game[/td]
[td]90 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Standard Edition[/td]
[td]90 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Deluxe Edition/Deluxe Edition Upgrade[/td]
[td]180 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa + Exclusive Pet Skin - Strong Friend Mekka[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Collector’s Edition/Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/td]
[td]Lifetime Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa + Exclusive Pet Skin - Strong Friend Mekka[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/7b147334a295042323e2ea0b490daaa39e78eff7.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we will be providing Early Access players with a permanent Rose Festival Weapon Skin (this can be used on any class, and the skin will fit appropriately to whatever character the player chooses) if they log in to Bless between 10/23 and 11/18. This skin cannot be sold, traded, destroyed or dismantled. As these rewards can be earned throughout the time period, they will be sent out on a rolling basis at regular intervals.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/abe9f4d3392c21d4f04d0d100c3586f028ffdaf0.jpg[/img]

However, we still have more rewards to give! All players who log in at least once between 10/23 and 11/18 will also be provided with a 14-day temporary legendary flying mount (Summoned Demon of the Beyond.) This item will be distributed in the same way as the Rose Festival Weapon Skin.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/33be721804ab8d6a99c7e750d0f34eb18ba54b4f.jpg[/img]

We also wish to note that on the lifetime Premium Membership reward that comes with the Collector’s Edition purchase tier, the number of days shown will be 1095. This is simply due to a limitation within our system for giving Premium Membership time in advance and does not reflect the actual length of the membership. After the 1095 days are up, the Premium Membership will renew again for another 1095 days. Additionally, the gathering bag, pickaxe, mount skin and pet skins from the Premium Membership will be provided as permanent items.

We truly appreciate all of the enthusiasm and support that players have shown for Bless, and we hope that these rewards for our Founders at the official F2P launch reflect our gratitude.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

With the release date announced and quickly approaching, we wanted to take a look back at the development of Bless Online and how far we’ve come since the announcement that we would be bringing the game to Steam. It’s been a long road, and know that every step we’ve taken we couldn’t have made without you, our community.

[b]The Road to Bless Online[/b]

Bless has always been a passion project for Neowiz. From the moment of its announcement, the team wanted to do everything possible to make sure that not only was Bless Online an amazing player experience, but also that it reached as many audiences as possible. Thanks to this drive, in 2017, Neowiz announced that it would be self-publishing Bless on Steam. By publishing to a global audience on the biggest PC gaming platform, Bless would achieve the goals of a wide multi-national reach. Additionally, the team shared that the game would be first in Early Access on Steam, as many changes would be made to the game before its official release. 

However, before Early Access on Steam began, beta tests were held on servers in Japan, Korea, and Russia. The team worked to listen to player feedback from the beta, gathering valuable feedback on what players did and didn’t like. Through this, the team realized that one of the main, important changes to make for the Steam release would be the combat system. They saw that players wanted a faster, more fluid and action-focused way to fight. While the team worked on the massive combat and UI overhaul, plans for Steam and Early Access were already in motion.

[b]Early Access[/b]

Neowiz Bless Studio saw Early Access as a chance to continue engaging with the player base in a similar way to the betas held in other regions. Bless, to the team, was not finished; Early Access was a time of development and continued improvement. 

The goal was also to gather more feedback specifically from the NA and EU audiences that Bless would be targeted to with its debut on Steam. The player response to Bless coming to Steam was initially very positive; players were thrilled to have Bless releasing for a global audience on one of the most accessible gaming platforms. However, many players didn’t share the team’s view that Early Access was still a time for development and changes. Bless Online wasn’t a final, polished product as much of the community had believed it would be, leading to a mismatch of expectations for Early Access between the development team and the players.

Despite this, the team saw Early Access as a success, collecting important data and feedback from players that could be applied to the completed experience that they knew players would get with the official launch planned for 2018. The new combat system that had been added was received with much praise, and the team new that by listening to player suggestions, more such improvements could be made as the team prepared to leave Early Access in 2018. 

[b]Official Release and Beyond[/b]

With the free-to-play model and official release date now announced and quickly approaching at the end of October, the team is not only thinking about how to have an amazing launch on Steam as the game leaves Early Access, but also about what players will want to see next. 

For the launch itself, free-to-play was chosen as the model in order to provide the best experience for both new incoming players and those who had been with the game since the start of Early Access. With more new players and the game being more accessible, the world of Bless would only become more lively and vibrant. 

The team also knew that they wanted to provide special rewards for all those who had joined the game during Early Access. The support of the players and willingness to give feedback shaped Bless into the game that will be releasing at the end of October, and the team is very grateful. Players showed that they had an endless supply of valuable feedback on topics ranging from avoiding pay-to-win in item sales to balancing combat for PvP. Though Bless will be releasing in a completed state for official launch, there will always be room for feedback and an ongoing conversation with the community about what they need and want. 

After launch, of course, there is a world of possibilities. The Bless team isn’t ready to talk about all of the details, but it has been well-noted what big content items players are interested in: adding classes such as the Mystic, new raids and dungeons, and new in-game goals to strive for. The team looks forward to exploring this all with players, but first: we launch! 

Sincerely,
The Bless Team
