notes.title: Bless Online Official Release Date and F2P Model Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, dear Bless Online players! 

Today we have some very exciting news to share with you, so let’s get right to it!

[b]Bless Online Official Release October 23, 2018[/b]

First, Bless Online will be officially releasing on October 23, 2018! We can’t wait to show you the improvements and content we have been working on for the launch. 


[b]Bless Online Goes Free to Play[/b]

Second, at full release, Bless Online will be going Free-to-Play, as we believe that model will provide the best experience for all players at official release. We intend to introduce as many people as possible to the feature-complete form of Bless Online. After several months of Early Access development and invaluable feedback and support from our Founders, players, and community members, Neowiz is ready to launch Bless Online this fall as a Free-to-Play experience. Those individuals who have previously purchased Bless Online will be provided in-game rewards marking their contributions to the game.

As a gift of appreciation to all our founders who supported Bless through Early Access, we will be giving rewards based on purchased game pack tiers.

[table]
[tr]
[th]REWARD TIER[/th]
[th]REWARD ITEMS[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Base Game[/td]
[td]90 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Standard Edition[/td]
[td]90 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Deluxe Edition/Deluxe Edition Upgrade[/td]
[td]180 Day Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa + Exclusive Pet Skin - Strong Friend Mekka[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Collector’s Edition/Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/td]
[td]Lifetime Premium Membership + Exclusive Costume skin - Great Lord Pysus' Nobility Set + Exclusive Mount Skin - Lumen Type Mobile Weapon, Nepa + Exclusive Pet Skin - Strong Friend Mekka[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/e9848ac5ecef0ac1b7b4ede4d155d85edbd8c6bd.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ce43b6b5f371eb53ba05a322914fcb707436f162.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/44de783bbdea27dafc3b2fecd6035942abd243da.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a6f8a77022a49245997a14a2494a946e884ffb16.jpg[/img]

We also plan to provide special weapon skins to Early Access players who return to Bless within a specific period of time after the official release. 

We hope that all our players will enjoy these rewards for their immeasurable support as they continue in their Bless Online experience into the official launch and beyond!


[b]Patala Raid Raid Update and Halloween Content[/b]

Today we released a new update containing the completely new Patala raid. In it, a party of up to 10 players can enter and test themselves against the 6 bosses contained within the dungeon. Players must be level 45 and have a minimum gear score of 8913 to enter, and can do so once per week. 

Rewards for defeating the various mid-bosses include Ananta's Flame, Contorted Wings of the Beyond, Contorted Chain of the Beyond, and the Animosity armor series. Rewards for defeating the final boss of Patala include the Sword Body of Flogas, the Storm weapon series, and new legendary level 45 weapons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c7e32ac601805a90a766dc8cf698b94f8d9b19d0.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we are adding new Halloween-themed costumes for players to wear in the spirit of the season! Starting today, October 4th, players can also participate in the Halloween in game events, which consist of 5 quests that ask players to defeat pumpkin-headed enemies, collect candy, and much more for special rewards.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/29ea8289cfcc6ee1c3c97e09f879ffd31155249c.jpg[/img]

As you can see, there is a lot to enjoy and look forward to in Bless in the coming days, weeks, and months. As always, thank you for your time and support! We look forward to seeing you out there in the world of Bless Online.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Update Preview] Patala Raid and Halloween Events
notes.content:
Hello, players! With a new update coming next week, we wanted to give you all a look at what exciting content is in store.

[b]Patala Raid[/b]

First up is a brand new raid! This dungeon is for a maximum of ten players in a raid party, and can be entered by talking with the NPC Anahrata, the Patala Ruins Seal Guide, near the entrance of the ruins. Players must be level 45 and have a minimum gear score of 8913 to enter, and can do so once per week.

Players will encounter six bosses within the dungeon, including the final boss Ananta, who can drop rewards such as the Sword Body of Flogas (a material for enhancing weapons), the Storm weapon series, and new legendary level 45 weapons. The mid-bosses drop other rewards, including Ananta's Flame (a material used for crafting Lvl 45 legendary armor), Contorted Wings of the Beyond and Contorted Chain of the Beyond (materials for enhancing armor), and the Animosity armor series.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c7e32ac601805a90a766dc8cf698b94f8d9b19d0.jpg[/img]


[b]Halloween Events[/b]

In addition to the new raid, it’s spooky season! We know you love this time of year, and so do we. To celebrate it, we have a whole bunch of themed events for you to take part in Bless!

The October login event will be running from October 1 - October 31, and players who log in for fifteen days will be able to receive 50 sapphires, 350 rose stones, and 230 beryl! For logging in and getting an Attendance Check on the other fourteen days, players will be given a variety of rewards including magic pet and mount animas, pet and mount skins, Nutrition Refreshments, a companion skill change token, and more! Further details about the event will be released soon.

In-game, things are even more festive! The Halloween events will be held from October 4 - November 7th, and during that time players can participate in several different quests.

[i]Jack-O’-Lantern Event[/i]

Players can find the NPC to start these quests either in the Noble’s District Cemetery inside Hieracon (for Hieron) or in the Cemetery Park in Spezia (for Union). From there, players receive the first quest, Memories of the Ghost Festival, and are asked to collect several appropriately themed items to complete the quest, including a scary mask, a knife, and candy. Players are then rewarded with a Scary Ghost Festival Set that includes a mask and costume.

The second quest, Preparations for the Ghost Festival, asks players to gather pumpkin items. Players who complete the quest will get a 30 day Scary Ghost Festival mask.

The third Jack-O’-Lantern quest, Festival Lights, requires players to defeat certain dungeon bosses (who will be sporting pumpkins on their heads) and collect Flames of Souls from them. Upon quest completion, players will receive a Jack-o'-lantern Lucky Box.

[i]Witch Raven Event[/i]

Witch Raven, the NPC for this quest set, can be found in Skaa Village for both Hieron and Union players. The first quest, Candy or Corn, asks players to collect Cursed Candy by defeating monsters in the Cornus region who drop the item. Once players collect the candy, they will be awarded the Insightful Lens From the Other World that they will need for the next quest,  and 10 Greater Taming Scrolls.

For Mysterious Rumor, the next quest, players will need to use the Insightful Lens From the Other World to begin. This will allow them to see a new NPC in the Cornus Valley that they must defeat. After attaining victory and turning in the quest, players will get a 7-day Creepy Skull Horse mount.

 
In the final quest, Visitor in the Dark, players must succeed in the Kuat Ran raid, after which they will be mailed items that will allow them to craft a Witch’s Lucky Pouch. Upon turning this item in to Witch Raven, players may receive either a Witch’s Lucky Pouch or a Handkerchief with the Breath of the Battlefield.

[i]Other Halloween Treats[/i]

Additionally, during the Halloween Event time, players may acquire pumpkins at random when gathering. They can then use these to craft Scary Ghost Festival Masks. NPCs may also randomly spawn when players are gathering, and if the player successfully tames them, they may obtain a Magic Rare pet at random. These tameable NPCs can also spawn during the fight with the Mysterious Rumors NPC if the player succeeds in bringing the NPC’s health below a certain level.

As a bonus, all throughout the Halloween event, if players die, they will receive a pumpkin head rather than resurrection after effects.

We look forward to seeing you all showing your Halloween spirit with your new costumes! We don’t think anyone will “boo” your new looks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/29ea8289cfcc6ee1c3c97e09f879ffd31155249c.jpg[/img]

Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.content:

[b]The Great Bot Purge of 2018[/b]

Hello players!

As part of our team’s efforts to ensure Bless provides a fair, balanced, and overall positive play experience, we have recently doubled down on our efforts to identify, target, and remove bots, cheaters, and other accounts in violation of our Terms of Service.

On August 30th, we completed a wave of removal, during which time numerous offenders were eliminated, and we don’t plan on stopping there. We take these violations seriously, and will continue to remove those accounts and individuals who we determine to engage in activities through which they are knowingly degrading the play experience for others, and ultimately contribute to toxicity within our community.

As we continue these efforts, please feel free to submit further tickets letting us know of anything you see or think we might have missed. We appreciate any info you share with us!

[b]Emissary Applications Open Now[/b]

Additionally, as part of our mission to foster a diverse range of Bless-related communities, we’re encouraging all of you who have a passion for creating positive and entertaining content to apply for an Emissary role! Anyone who wants to partner with us for giveaways, fun in-game and out-of-game events and more as we near launch should show us in their application that they want to help us reach new players around the globe!

Emissary applications are now open, and will remain open until Sept. 16th. 

If you have questions about the program, please refer to the [url=https://www.blessonline.net/news_read/214]Emissary Program Overview[/url] for additional details.

[b]Maintenance Compensation Plans[/b]

Though we always strive to provide sufficient notice for maintenances, there will still be occasional instances where we need to perform emergency maintenances or updates with limited notice. In these cases, we want to make sure impacted players are compensated for the inconvenience.

Here are the planned gifts for different types of maintenances:
[list]
[*]Regular maintenance over 5 hours - [i]Premium buff extension for the equivalent maintenance time[/i]

[*]Regular maintenance that lasts longer than the projected time by more than 30 minutes - [i]Box(es) of temporary buff items in accordance with maintenance duration[/i]

[*]Unplanned emergency maintenance - [i]Premium buff extension for the equivalent maintenance time, and box(es) of temporary buff items in accordance with maintenance duration[/i]
[/list]
We also want to compensate players in cases of critical errors within the game. As such, in the case of these errors causing players to lose items or buffs, we will restore the items and give an additional gift of Lumena to the player according to the severity of the error.

Compensation will be given to all players affected by critical errors, and the case of maintenances, to players who have logged into the game approximately 24 hours before and/or after the start of the maintenance.


Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: Bless Online v.2.1.0.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a0e7cd73350a30ffb43f3d16c28d837cbd4292f0.jpg[/img]

[b]Bless Online v2.1.0.0 update[/b]
[h1][New Content: Rift of Space and Time][/h1]
Check out a preview [url=https://youtu.be/af2CDCqxWQA]here![/url]
https://youtu.be/af2CDCqxWQA
[olist]
[*] Updated the new content “Rift of Space and Time”
- The Rift of Space and Time is a wave defense type content where players in small groups fight to protect the relic from approaching monsters every round.

- Minimum player level: 45
- Number of players: Maximum of three people.
- Entrance limit: 2 times a week.
- How to enter:[list]
[*] Can be accessed through the entrance of the dungeon located around Bleached Desert > Black Gate (1-3 players).
[*] Can be accessed by clicking on the Rift of Space and Time menu from the “War (B)” > “Competition” on the System Menu (3 players). [/list]
- Stages: There are 2 stages each with different maps, and there are a total of 10 rounds per stage (Total of 20 rounds).

- [b]How to play[/b]: [list]
[*] The round will begin once players activate the defense equipment located in the center of the Tower of Distorted Dimension. Each round is cleared when all monsters that appear from specific areas are defeated.
[*] Players can use the “Marks of Space and Time” obtained by finishing the rounds/defeating monsters at the Shop NPC to obtain the useful Summon Scroll item.
[/list]

- [b]Main Rewards[/b]: [list]
[*] Players will get Challenge Points based on their results in the Rift of Space and Time after the dungeon is cleared. Players can use the points to purchase bracelet enhancement material, “Fighting Spirit Magic Stone” from the Bracelet Enhancement Material Merchant by talking with the NPC Priest Gatarina.
[*] Quest rewards: Players can obtain a new bracelet item “Old Iron Bracelet” if players accept and complete the quest where they are asked to successfully defeat the boss of the 5th round.
[*] Players have a chance to obtain one bracelet item if they defeat the bosses that appear in either round 10 or 20.
[/list]

- [b]Ranking System[/b]: [list]
[*] Players’ rank will be determined based on the number of the cleared rounds and play time and the top 100 players will appear in the ranking UI.
[*] Ranking rewards: [list]
[*] The day which the rewards are provided: Every Tuesday
[*] Players can obtain different amount of Challenge Points based on their rank, and if they are placed in a higher rank, the players can obtain “Rift of Space and Time Lucky Dip Box” which will randomly give a new equipment bracelet.
[*] Even if players are placed in the ranking for multiple times, they will only receive the rewards for their highest rank. [/list]
[/list]
[/olist]

[h1][New Content: Random Dungeon][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Updated the new content “Random Dungeon”.
- Minimum player level: 45
- Entrance limit: 2 times per day
- Equipment Point Entrance Limit: 6,190
- How to enter: Can be accessed by clicking on the “Dungeon” UI > Random Dungeon menu on the System.
- Rewards list: Players will receive receive additional rewards for the Random Dungeon in addition to the standard dungeon reward If players defeat the final boss for the dungeon they are in. The rewards for Random Dungeon will always be the same regardless of the actually cleared dungeon.

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Item Name[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Pure Moonlight Powder[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Mysterious Material Lucky Box
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Mysterious Food Lucky Box[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Mysterious Mount Lucky Box[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Mysterious Puzzle Lucky Box[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

- Player level and equipment stats will be automatically scaled to the appropriate level for the dungeon upon entrance.
[/olist]

[h1][Modified Contents][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Combat
- The chain combo buttons (R/T/Y) will now be activated at the actual time when the skills are available.
[*] UI
- A system message will now appear on all servers when an enhancement is successful only if the item is over Heroic grade or over +13.
- A system message will now appear on all servers when an item is registered on the Market only if said item is over Heroic grade, over +13 or over Transcendent Enhancement.
[/olist]

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Combat
- Fixed an issue where the Chain Combo Skills would not appear when using the Chain Skills after repeatedly clicking on the Tactic Switch Button.
- Fixed an issue where some skills would be disabled under certain conditions.
[*] UI
- Fixed an issue where the schedule of Capital War appears differently from the actual time on the UI.
- Fixed an issue where the icons for the pet skills “Crafter’s Delight” and “Collector’s Delight” would appear differently.
- Fixed an issue where the Healing reduction effect caused by “Bleeding” during the additional switching effect of the Assassin class’ “Raid” skill would not appear on the tooltip.
- Fixed an issue where the system message “This is a dungeon for solo players” would appear when party members that were outside a dungeon were summoned inside it and even when the dungeon wasn't meant for solo players.
[*] Dungeon

notes.title: [Update Preview] - Rift of Space and Time & the Random Dungeon
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b3a2655bded6dd02047c8fc6a03a8c00fb87a403.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

We’ve been hard at work on the next update to Bless Online, and today we’ll spend a few moments talking about the coming update (v2.1.0.0), set release on Sept. 5th! The focus of this update is new level 45 content: Rift of Space and Time, and the Random Dungeon.

[b]Rift of Space and Time[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/dbc909861f41d3f93b242e23c69651e191b51a53.jpg[/img]

The Rift of Space and Time offers players a new type of end-game quest: a wave defense challenge featuring two stages with differing maps, random monster waves, and a whopping 20 rounds! Better yet, this challenge is one of the ways to obtain a new type of equipment, bracelets!

Bracelets can be obtained by completing related quests, killing boss monsters, and as a ranking reward in Rift of Space of Time. The efficiency of bracelets can differ depending on the acquisition method.

Rift of Space and Time is available for players to queue solo or in a party of three, and requires players to guard a relic which the ensuing monster waves will be intent on destroying. Monsters will appear from various parts of the map (so check your six!), and differ with each round. Once a round is cleared, new monsters will then appear.

Upon clearing rounds, players will receive Marks of Space and Time, which can then be used at the Shop NPC to obtain items such as Summon Scrolls. Summon Scrolls will come in handy when executing your strategic gameplans to clear all 20 rounds! But beware, Marks of Space and Time cannot be cached, but will instead disappear upon completion of the Rift of Space and Time, or simply when the instance ends; so use them while you have them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5f56a0a594ae3438afa9da37bb04de7bafd46272.jpg[/img]

Those of you who manage to defeat the boss that appears at Rounds 10, and another at Round 20, will be guaranteed one of two bracelets (different depending on rounds cleared)! What’s more, players who place in the Top 10 will receive a set item that will 100% generate a bracelet. 

How do you place in the Top 10, you ask? At the conclusion of each attempt, players will receive a personal and overall rank, letting them know how well they’re performed. Performance will in turn determine the Challenge Points awarded to that player, which can be used to purchase the material Fighting Spirit Magic Stone from the shops around the Rift of Space and Time to then upgrade your bracelet. So perfect your strategy, execute flawlessly, and place yourself amongst the best of the best for sweet, sweet loot!

[b]Random Dungeon[/b]

The Random Dungeon is a new dungeon matching option that provides level 45 players the opportunity, twice per day, to solo-queue into dungeons (excluding raid dungeons) for a shot at looting Pure Moonlight Powder, Mysterious Mount Lucky Boxes, Mysterious Puzzle Lucky Boxes and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c4dc6cfb2164c2d1655b9e33febbbcd7f158adde.jpg[/img]

If you and your fellow dungeoneering compatriots successfully defeat the final boss for the dungeon you are in, you will receive said dungeon’s standard rewards, in addition to any of the possible rewards provided by the Random Dungeon.

So what are you waiting for?! You’ve got your work cut out for you, now go forth and enjoy!

Thank you,

The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer's Letter] New Content, In-Game Events, Emissaries and More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/765a16afb7901bd5e59708c99eabd29d43f5434e.jpg[/img]

Greetings, players!

We hope you have been continuing to enjoy the Assassin and new content. We have some new updates coming up on the horizon, in addition to the Emissary Applications opening at the end of the month, and wanted to share some info about it with you. These updates will be bringing not only new content, but fixes and improvement to the Assassin and more. As always, these updates are just a step along the path to the full release of Bless Online on Steam later this year!

[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1691552256145376572]The 8/22 Update[/url][/b]

We focused on issues that the community felt strongly about, and wanted to address as quickly as we could.

[i]Runes[/i]
[list][*]We heard your feedback that you didn’t enjoy having runes break in various PvP settings. With this update, runes will no longer break in battlegrounds (or Siege of Castra, which was already changed in a previous update).[/list]

[i]Assassin[/i]
[list][*]We made some fixes and adjustments to the Assassin shortly after release due to player reports and feedback, but certain things needed to be monitored for a longer period of time to determine the best direction for changes. As we have been able to gather enough feedback and data, we are adjusting the skills Massacre, Hack, Pierce, and more with this update. Please let us know your thoughts after you have tried out the changes![/list]

[i]Flamelord Flogas[/i]
[list][*]We will be fixing the bug with Flamelord Flogas elite's skill that previously cast skills in a wrong way when starting to battle it in the Migra Turis dungeon (Normal / Elite). Thank you for your patience while we addressed this issue. We also recognize the impact on player experience that has resulted from the safezone issue with Flamelord Flogas, are working to resolve it, and hope to have a solution in the near future.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/d440a1d966e422739abe862dc389363df22fe593.jpg[/img]

[b]The 9/5 Update[/b]

The beginning of the next month will bring new content, new in-game events, and more fixes and improvements.

[i]Rift of Space and Time[/i]
[list][*]You will take on the ‘Rift of Space and Time,’ a level 45 wave defense type event, in groups of three (queuing either by yourself or with a party of no more than three), and protect a relic from approaching monsters every round.[/list]

[i]Random Dungeon[/i]
[list][*]“Random Dungeon” allows level 45 players, once per day, to queue into a random dungeon for the opportunity to gain additional loot. Once the instance’s final boss has been defeated, you will earn additional loot as well as the regular dungeon rewards you are accustomed to. You can participate in this content by selecting Random Dungeon within the Dungeon window.[/list]

[i]Chain Combo Improvements[/i]
[list][*]We’ve been working on polishing up the combo experience, and in this update have made the chain combo buttons even more responsive to player input.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ffb849b98dd23eeaec6145912569e645b8b67cea.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9e437dd4b97d6a2dd057c9e77fb4be6d24a006ef.jpg[/img]

We look forward to hearing your feedback on the new content and improvements that will be added soon! As we work to prepare for Bless Online’s full release later this year, we will continue to incorporate the community in the process. On that same track, Emissary Applications will be opening again at the end of this month! Keep an eye out for more info coming soon.


Always at your service,

Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: Bless Unleashed Announced for Console - Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4ae6251702237f62c3adc6001d1183b1ee21d7d4.jpg[/img]

[b] Good morning, all! [/b]

You all must be wondering about the surprise announcement of Bless Unleashed for Xbox One coming in 2019. We, the Bless Online team, know you’ll have a lot of questions surrounding the coexistence of Bless Online and Bless Unleashed. [i]The fact is - they’re two separate games in the same universe. Bless Unleashed is not a port of Bless Online to console.[/i]

Rest assured that more information will be available about Bless Unleashed from the Bless Unleashed team in the near future, and that there will be news for you on the launch of Bless Online on Steam in the coming weeks as well.

In the interim, here are some common questions asked about this development.


[h1] Frequently Asked Questions [/h1]

[b] Q: Will development be focused on the console version now? [/b]

[b]A:[/b] No, Bless Unleashed (console) will not take any focus away from Bless Online (PC), as they are handled by two completely different dev teams making two completely different games. Our team’s focus is still committed to bringing Bless Online players the best experience possible for the foreseeable future.

[b]Q: Why would this game be made if Bless Online on Steam is still a priority? Does this mean the PC version is now less important?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] Bless Unleashed is being developed by a completely different team, Round 8 Studio. They are a studio formed for the creation of Bless Unleashed. There are also separate publishing units that focus on each Bless Unleashed (console) and Bless Online (PC). Specifically, Bandai Namco Entertainment America is the publishing partner for Bless Unleashed, while Neowiz Bless Studio self-publishes Bless Online through multiple teams across the world. Bless Online on Steam will be still a priority for its own dedicated team.

[b]Q: How does the team plan to manage the two games at once?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] There are different teams that can focus their attention towards each game, with the console release seeing additional support from our publishing partner. Neowiz Bless Studio and our North American team is managing Bless Online, and Bandai Namco Entertainment America is handling the publishing efforts of Bless Unleashed on Xbox One.

[b]Q: How will the console title be handled differently than Bless Online in Early Access?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] Again, Bless Online and Bless Unleashed are two unique games, sharing the same IP. Early Access for Bless Online has been an opportunity to learn from the player base and make improvements and adjustments leading up to the full release on Steam. The goal of Early Access on Steam was to help us make the necessary changes to Bless Online to make it ready for the Western full release - which is still planned for this year.

[b]Q: The release date of the Bless Online Steam (full launch) hasn’t been announced yet, will Bless Unleashed and Bless Online be released at the same time?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] While the exact release dates for either game haven’t been announced, know that Bless Online will fully launch on Steam later this year, while Bless Unleashed on Xbox One will be launched in 2019.

[b]Q: Why is Bless Unleashed being released so closely after Bless Online?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] The decision to make a new game for consoles was made independently of Bless Online’s launch on Steam. Ultimately, the goal is to see the Bless IP thrive in as many places and for as many players as possible. As such, the decision was made to make a new game for Xbox One owners. It retains the world and style of Bless Online, but is a completely new experience with console players in mind.

[b]Q: How is Bless Unleashed different from Bless Online? How is it a “different game”, other than the use of Unreal Engine 4?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] Every aspect, from the story to the combat, to the skill progression has been carefully crafted to portray a new console MMORPG experience. Bless Online and Bless Unleashed are completely different games, sharing a similar art style and existing in the same game world. More details on Bless Unleashed will be revealed in the coming weeks.

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] Reflections on the Update, Future Adjustments, and Upcoming Emissary Applications
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]
Greetings, players!

[b]The Assassin Update[/b]

We hope you all have been enjoying the the Assassin Update that released earlier this week, as well as the discounts, giveaways, and in-game events going on to celebrate it! The team is excited that they were able to finally share the content for the update that they have been working so hard on.

We know that the urgent maintenance that took place after the update inconvenienced many of you, and we apologize for that, though it was necessary for server stability. However, we would like to give you all a gift of 500 Lumena as compensation for the issues caused. Additionally, those with active Premium Membership buffs will receive a one hour extension on them; you can read about the compensation details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1701684721089094438)] here.	[/url] The Bless team will continue to do their best to ensure server stability.

We have been tracking numbers, and are happy that you all are enjoying Siege of Castra! The first siege was completely full, with hundreds of players in queue. As such, we are going to be expanding the number of channels for Siege of Castra so that even more players can enjoy it. In order to provide the best player experience for the number of participants, our developers are currently monitoring the situation in order to prepare for opening another channel.

We also heard your feedback that you didn’t like runes/spirits breaking. As such, we plan to include an update in the near future so that runes/spirits no longer break in Peninsular War or Siege of Castra.

We have also heard reports of some issues with the Assassin’s skills. We investigated this, and discovered that there was an issue with one of the Assassin’s skill tooltip translations. We did a minor patch last night to address the issue,and also fixed the bug where players were not able to select other members of their raid party in this patch. We are also continuing to monitor feedback regarding class balance, especially for the Assassin, and will take such feedback into account for the next overall class balance patch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a0b90d2a16f93d480975c54a59fe8e57fa290c9d.jpg[/img]


[b]Emissary Applications[/b]

In the coming weeks, we will be reopening Emissary applications. We have been making some exciting changes to the program behind the scenes, and will look forward to welcoming new members to a refreshed, restructured experience. Keep an eye on our social channels:

[url=https://twitter.com/BlessOnline] Twitter	[/url] 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/BlessOnline/] Facebook 	[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/e39ZygQ] Discord 	[/url]

 for more news on the next round of applications later this month, as they will only be open for a limited time! However, keep in mind that even if you aren’t selected for the next round, there will be future opportunities to join the program.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6e1a0b0be93c119f7c993b1ada21c48dd35e8b6f.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, but we’ll have more news to share as we move towards launch!

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

[h1]Become the Shadows[/h1]

The Assassin class debuts today! Watch out for daggers and sneak attacks...

You can see a preview of the stealthy new class in action in our Assassin trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qyX8rVk61mA&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Bless Online v.2.0.0.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9c656093d61e6194486bc79930d8fece68f5e06a.jpg[/img]

[b] Bless Online v2.0.0.0 update [/b]

[h1][New Character Class - Assassin][/h1]
Attacking from the shadows, meet the stealthy Assassin class [url=https://youtu.be/qyX8rVk61mA]here[/url]!
https://youtu.be/qyX8rVk61mA
[olist]
[*] Added the new "Assassin" character class

i. Concept:
Assassins are masters of stealth and guile, so watch out; if you let your guard down you may find yourself poisoned, ambushed, or just quietly stabbed. Assassins are often focused on one thing and one thing only: the elimination of their target! If you allow one to sneak up behind you, you may not live to regret it.

ii. Races that can be played as Assassin:
- Hieron: Habicht, Sylvan Elf, Mascu
- Union: Amistad, Aqua Elf, Pantera, Mascu

iii. Recommended equipment and suitable materials:
Recommended Equipment: 
* Weapon: Dagger
* Armor: Light Armor, Medium Armor

- If appropriate armor for the Assassin class is equipped, the beneficial effects provided can differ according to the number of equipped pieces and player level (under / over Level 30).
* Defense Effect : Increase in Dodge rate
* Attack Effect : Increase in Fighting Power, Critical Hit rate, and Critical Hit damage

iv. Targeting Mode: Compatible with both Action-targeting and Tab-targeting 

v. Tactics:
- Main Stances:

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Stance[/th]
	[th]Name[/th]
	[th]Characteristics[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 1[/td]
	[td]Assassinate[/td]
	[td]An assassination type stance that focuses on attacking the enemy from behind.
- Damage is increased if attacking from behind.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 2[/td]
	[td]Withstand[/td]
	[td]A combat type stance that focuses on fighting enemies from the front.
- Increases  normal Attack Power.
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 3[/td]
	[td]Raid[/td]
	[td]A surprise attack type stance that focuses on quickly attacking the enemy from behind.
- Increases Critical Hit after a movement skill.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 4[/td]
	[td]Poison[/td]
	[td]A poison stance that covers the enemy in poison.
- Inflicts additional damage to enemies with [Poison] or [Venom].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 5[/td]
	[td]Throw[/td]
	[td]A long range stance that focuses on attacking the enemy by throwing daggers. 
- The skill after a throwing skill will be a critical hit.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Tactic 6[/td]
	[td]Execute[/td]
	[td]A finishing stance that gets stronger the lower the enemy’s HP is.
- Increases the damage of Last Chain Skills.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

- When the Mark of Death is stacked to the maximum, consume it to maximize stance switch effects.
* Players must utilize the effect where the amount of the Mark of Death is returned based on the amount consumed. 
* Since the main way to obtain Malevolence is by switching stances, players must continually switch stances to manage Malevolence.

[/olist]

[h1][New Content - Siege of Castra][/h1]

[olist]
[*] Added Siege of Castra.
- Large scale (maximum 70 vs 70) PvP content available during scheduled times that divides players by faction (Hieron and Union) to determine victory.

[b] i. How to Join / Event Details: [/b]

- Players can register to join beginning 10 minutes before the start time through the War UI in the system menu.
- If there is an imbalance between participants in both factions, there will be queues. Players enter the game in order of their queue number.
- Players can join starting at level 25. Their level will be scaled to 45 upon entrance.
- It will last a maximum of 30 minutes. The faction that defeats the opposing faction’s Lord Commander NPC within 30 minutes wins. If no one defeats the Lord Commander NPC within 30 minutes, the match will end in a tie.
- The schedule for Siege of Castra is as follows (4 times daily):

[NA region] *PDT
[table]
[tr]
	[td]10:00[/td]
	[td]14:00[/td]
	[td]19:00[/td]
	[td]22:00[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[EU region] *CEST
[table]
[tr]
	[td]01:00[/td]
	[td]13:00[/td]
	[td]17:00[/td]
	[td]22:00[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[b] ii. Main Rewards [/b]

- Players may earn Combat Points depending on their level of contribution while participating in Siege of Castra. The winning team will receive more rewards than the losing team. Also, players who received quests from NPCs within the battlefield will receive additional rewards upon victory.

[b] iii. Main Objects: [/b]

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Name[/th]
	[th]Characteristics[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Purifying Tree[/td]
	[td]A vindictive spirit is summoned if players knock down the Purifying Tree. The vindictive spirit is allied with the faction that knocked down the Purifying Tree. It will then summon “Corrupted Plant” underlings and charge towards the enemy faction’s door or Lord Commander NPC.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Guardian Stone[/td]
	[td]The Guardian Stone is created 2 minutes after the battlefield’s vindictive spirit spawns and belongs to the faction that knocked down the Purifying Tree. When the Guardian Stone is destroyed by the opposing faction, the vindictive spirit will disappear, and the faction that destroyed the stone will receive an Attack Power, Ability Power, and Movement Speed increase buff.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Artillery[/td]
	[td]There is artillery that protects each faction located in each faction’s headquarters. These automatically attack approaching/ invading characters from the enemy faction.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[/olist]

[h1] [Additional Content - Dominion Contract (DC) and Capital War (CW)] [/h1]

[olist]
[*] Dominion Contract:

- Dominion Contract refers to the contract that grants the authority to rule over specific territory within the affiliated faction. The guild leader of the guild that succeeds in the Dominion Contract will become a Baron or Governor and their guild will become eligible to participate in the Capital War, which is where the Guardians of the Faction are determined.

[b] i. How to Join / Rules [/b]

- The Dominion Contract is awarded through the Auction and the guild that successfully bids last will win the territory.  
- Dominion Contract lasts for 40 minutes, and guild leaders can make a bid by using their total amount of Guild Influence points.
- The bidding fee is 10% of the guild’s Guild Influence Points and guild leaders will get 90% of their Guild Influence Points (excluding the 10%) back if their bid fails. Players can also bid extra amounts as much as they want even while the auction is ongoing. Additional bids can be done at a 10% or more of the previous bid price.

[b] ii. Schedule [/b]
- The Dominion Contract and Capital War will each be held once every 2 weeks, alternating every Saturday (e.g. 1st and 3rd Saturday = Capital War, 2nd and 4th = Dominion Contract).

- First Dominion Contract to start on August 11th (Saturday).
* NA: 18:00~18:40 *PDT
* EU: 21:00~21:40 *CEST

[b] iii. Areas available for Dominion Contract [/b] (5 per faction)

- Hieron: Lupuscana, Floren, Marta, Curia, Ostium
- Union: Navarra, Migdal, Campagna, Terny, Shaqqara

[b] iv. Main Rewards [/b]

- Rewards obtained when winning a Dominion Contract bid
* If you win the bid and end up owning territory, you also obtain Reign Points (RP).

* Guilds are rewarded with 2000 RP per territory
[i] * What are Reign Points? Reign Points are Activity points or EXP that can be obtained by players of the same faction in the same area controlled by a Baron or Governor. Players can check their Reign Points by going to the Guild menu [H]. Items can be purchased using Reign Points in the Reign Point Reward Shops through the Imperial Secretary or Federation Secretary who are located in the big cities. [/i]

- Reign Points obtained by winning a territory
* Guilds occupying a territory due to the Dominion Contract will receive RP daily.
[i] * 1 territory per day will earn the guild at least 1000 RP and a maximum of 3000 RP per day [/i]

[*] Capital War:

- Capital War is the battle to determine who will be the highest rank (Protector Marshall or High Praetor) in their respective faction. The roles are divided into offense and defense. Each faction’s Baron or Governor can join at a specific time to try to become the Protector Marshall or High Praetor, or form an alliance and contribute to the Capital War’s defense.

[b] i. How to Join / Rules [/b]

- Only the guild leader and guild vice leader of DC winning guilds that own a territory may request to join the Capital War, but once their request is accepted, the whole guild may join. Players can apply for the CW an hour before it starts for a period of 30 minutes (17:00~17:30 PDT / 20:00~20:30 CEST) or enter the battle by talking to the Capital War Manager NPC in either Hieracon or Spezia.
- Capital War lasts for 45 minutes, and within that time players must either protect or contest the Guardian Statue. If one succeeds in both defending and attacking then they will be rewarded with Reign Points and rewards.

[u]* First Protector Marshall / High Praetor Reward:[/u]
After the first Dominion Contract on August 8th, the guilds which won the DC and spent the highest amount of Influence Points will become Baron / Governor(Only the highest amount that was successfully bid for a territory will be taken into account). They will be automatically selected as the first Protector Marshall / High Praetor. The first Protector Marshall / High Praetor will not receive a reward for the Capital War. The Protect Marshall / High Praetor guilds that were appointed during the first Dominion Contract will participate as a defense alliance in the first Capital War on August 18th. After the first DC, the High Praetor / Protect Marshall will be decided depending on the outcome of the Capital War.

[u] * How the first Capital War will proceed: [/u]
The CW winner(Protector Marshall / High Praetor) can only defend while the remaining DC winners(Baron / Governor) may choose to either defend or attack during the Capital War. The CW winning guild may retain its position if it succeeds in defending, but if the attacking side succeeds, the guild leader who is successful in the interaction after the Guardian Statue is destroyed will become CW winner.

[b] ii. Schedule [/b]
- The Capital War takes place once every other week at the following times:
- First Capital War to start on August 18th (Saturday).
* NA: 18:00 - 18:45 *PDT
* EU: 21:00 - 21:45 *CEST

[b] iii. Main Rewards [/b]

- Rewards obtained when becoming the Capital War winner
* 20,000 RP will be rewarded to the winning guild
* A mount costume will be rewarded to the winning guild and guild members:
(Hieron: Guide of Honor (1 day), Union: Guide of Freedom (1 day))

- Rewards obtained while CW winner status is maintained
* A statue of the Protector Marshall / High Praetor guild leader will be erected in each faction’s capital city (Hieracon / Spezia). The statue will change if the Protector Marshall / High Praetor guild leader changes.

* Players may additionally obtain a set amount of the total amount of RP earned while they are still reigning over the territory. 
[i] The CW winning guild can obtain a minimum of 3000 to a maximum of 7000 RP [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/89f9974b1d1a58a3a936cfefa5f5f6039201ae62.png[/img]

[h1] [Modified Contents] [/h1]

[olist]
[*] Modified some of the Guardian’s skill effects in order to adjust the PvP balance.
- Decreased the amount of Defense reduction from 20% to 10% on the [Charge Tactic] passive effect.
- Decreased the amount of Damage reduction from 20% to 10% on the [Guard Tactic] passive effect.
- Decreased the amount of Damage reduction from 20% to 10% on the [Endurance Tactic] passive effect.

[*] Modified the Ranger’s [Locate] effects

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Type[/th]
	[th]Before[/th]
	[th]After[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Modified “Locate” skill[/td]
	[td]Applied [Detection] effect to nearby enemies.
[Detection] : Increases received damage by 5% for 5 seconds.[/td]
	[td]Reveals nearby enemies who have used [Stealth] and applies [Detection] effect to them.
[Detection] : Increases received damage by 5% for 5 seconds.
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Modified “Locate - Middle Node” skill[/td]
	[td]Revealed nearby enemies who had used [Stealth] and applied [Detection] effect to them.
[Detection] : Increases received damage by 5% for 5 seconds.
[/td]
	[td]Reveals nearby enemies who have used [Stealth] and applies [Detection] effect to them.
[Detection] :Increases received damage by 10% for 5 seconds.
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Modified “Locate - Middle Node” node[/td]
	[td]Revealed nearby enemies who had used [Stealth].
· Increased cooldown time to 25 seconds
· Increased Concentration consumption to 10 
[/td]
	[td]Reveals nearby enemies who have used [Stealth]
·  Increases cooldown time to 20 seconds 
· Increases damage received by the [Detection] effect by 5%  
· Increases Concentration consumption to 10 
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Modified “Locate - Lower Node” skill[/td]
	[td]Applied [Enervated] effect to nearby enemies.
 [Enervated] : Decreased Hit rate by 40% for 3 seconds.
[/td]
	[td]Reveals nearby enemies who have used [Stealth] and applies [Enervated] effect to them. [Enervated] : Decreases Hit rate by 40% for 3 seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Modified “Locate - Lower Node” node[/td]
	[td]Applied [Enervated] effect to nearby enemies.
· Increased cooldown time to 45 seconds
· Increased Concentration consumption to 30 
[/td]
	[td]Applies [Enervated] effect to nearby enemies.
· Increases cooldown time to 30 seconds 
· Increases Concentration consumption to 10
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[*] Fixed an issue where Emergency Escape was possible during battle.

[*] Improvements were made so that a "Chain Break' text appears whenever the chain is interrupted or is unsuccessful in order to allow players to react to the situation easier.

[*] Improved mount and pet stamina regeneration cycle.
- Reduced the regeneration cycle, making it appear on the Companion UI and action bar.

[*] Increased the damage obtained through an NPC decal skill overall.

[*] Modified the Critical Hit effect obtainable when equipping an Assassin class armor set in 4 areas. Balance was adjusted due to the armor set effects being too optimized compared to other classes’ armor set effects.

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Name of Armor[/th]
	[th]Before[/th]
	[th]After[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Clever Armor Set of Immortality[/td]
	[td]Dodge +17
Critical Hit Effect +30
[/td]
	[td]Dodge +17
Critical Hit Effect +1
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Furtive Armor Set of the Rider[/td]
	[td]Dodge +17
Critical Hit Effect +35

[/td]
	[td]Dodge+17
Critical Hit Effect +5
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Swift Armor of Dimension[/td]
	[td]Dodge +17
Critical Hit Effect +50
[/td]
	[td]Dodge+17
Critical Hit Effect +10

[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[/olist]

[h1] [Miscellaneous] [/h1]

[olist] 
[*] Added one extra slot to the maximum number of allowed characters (7 total).

[*] Improved visibility and usability of the Dungeon UI.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c1e542d0bcf2647c49bad82181ecb4f629a60087.jpg[/img]

[*] Improved Party Widget UI convenience.
- Expanded the clickable button to select party members. 

[*] Improved Guide Quest UI.
- Required conditions for Guide Quest will now also appear if there’s more than one or if it's optional in order to do the guide quest.
- Guide quests which only can be done in the tutorial zone will now display a message announcing this in the journal.

[*] An explanation can be seen when hovering the mouse cursor over the System Menu.

[*] Fixed an issue where characters would sometimes disappear at camera distance when they should be appearing.

[*] Added a deactivation setting to the Party / Raid widget.
- In order to solve the difficulties Paladins have when selecting a healing target, the widget will be deactivated if the distance between party and raid members is over a certain distance. 
- The distance can be changed by going to Interface -> Game Settings -> Status Info menu.

[i] * Default (max): 60m (Adjustment by 1m is possible between 30 - 60m range)[/i]

[*] The chain combo buttons (R/T/Y) will now be shown as active.

[*] The Peninsula War icon will now appear in the bottom right side of the screen when a Peninsula War is ongoing.

[*] Added an Energy gauge UI when sprinting.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/d8d0b287a34f0841c35fd336b81e31f3cb9954ce.jpg[/img]
- The left half of the original gauge will display the gauge used when sprinting.
- The mount’s status will be displayed in the mount stamina gauge.

[*] The tooltip UI was improved so as to increase recognition of stance skills.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c7b89258c4182ec5db4aa317d8257a38d62dd88d.jpg[/img]
- All node growth effects will be displayed individually.
- Acquired nodes will be displayed in white letters and unacquired nodes will be displayed in gray letters.

[*] Increased the character limit in chat from 100 to 120 characters.
- Added an option where it’s possible to view the character limit and the current number of characters.
[/olist]

[h1] [Bug Fixes] [/h1]

[b] i. Battle System [/b]

[olist]
[*] Fixed the suspected cause of the issue that arises when battling the final boss Flogas in Migra Turris (Normal / Elite) dungeon where the “Pillar of Biting Cold” would behave abnormally at times.
[i] * If this issue arises again, please take a screenshot or video and let us know through Customer Support. [/i]

[*] Fixed an issue where a pet’s passive effect would transfer to the character when the character died and the pet was unsummoned.

[*] Fixed an issue where Lumena would be deducted if a player failed to enter a dungeon right away.

[*] Fixed an issue where the minimum level required for using some beginner equipment was different according to character class. The minimum level is now set to level 1.

- Weapon: Longsword of the Trainee, Club of Training, Dagger of the Trainee, Axe of the Novice, Wand of the Beginner, Trainee’s Longbow, Stout Shield of the Apprentice
- Armor: “of the Trainee”, “of the Beginner”, “of the Novice” armor series

[*] Fixed an issue where characters with ranged attacks would be able to hunt a “Giant Malefic Blob” alone in certain Basel locations.

[*] Fixed an issue where combat would end abnormally for the hostile target and the character who healed the player if combat was ended for reasons outside of defeating the enemy after the player received healing effects while in combat.

[*] Fixed an issue where a Union character would be able to enter a Hieron territory through certain locations during the Peninsula War.

[*] Fixed an issue where a battle would still be ongoing even after a certain time has passed if the players were in a party battle against another character and the battle was interrupted.

[*] Modified the contents of the Paladin [Transcend] stance skill’s tooltip in order to make the skill clearer.

[/olist]

[b] ii. Quest [/b]

[olist]

[*] Fixed an issue where the “complete” text would appear abnormally and a quest’s conditions would appear again even after all the objectives in a guide quest are completed.

[*] Fixed an issue where the “on head tag” icon wouldn’t appear on a guide quest’s goal NPC and complete NPC.

[*] Fixed an issue where the message “Can only be performed while the basic guide is in progress” wouldn’t appear when doing guide quests in the tutorial zone.

[*] Fixed an issue in the “Old Friends” story quest where the kill count for the target NPC wouldn’t go up when the NPC was defeated if the player left the area, making it difficult to complete the quest.

[/olist]

[b] iii. UI / UX [/b]

[olist]

[*] Fixed an issue where the camera setting would show an area without the character if it had been zoomed out too much in spaces that weren’t a wide field.

- Added the camera setting value for the Mascu race which didn’t exist before. 
- Modified the maximum zoom out level of the default camera.

[*] Fixed an issue where the Spirit window would always pop up when right clicking on any Spirit item in the inventory. This popup window will now appear only when the player is able to use Spirits after reaching a certain level.

[*] Fixed an issue where recipes that couldn’t be learned wouldn’t be grayed out in the UI.

[*] A pop-up warning will now appear if a player doesn’t meet the requirements and level needed to learn each crafting skill when they are selecting a Main and Sub Crafting Skill.

[*] Fixed an issue where a pet’s stamina consumption would appear abnormally in the bottom shortcut favorites list if the list exceeded 2 pages.

[*] Fixed an issue where the UI text would appear abnormally when playing on a resolution higher than 2048 x 1280.

[*] Fixed an issue where the speech bubbles would appear smaller than they should on a 3840 x 2160 resolution.

[*] Fixed an issue where the inside of the dialogue window that popped up when talking to the Market Manager would be displayed abnormally if the player interacted with the Market Manager right after logging into the game.

[*] Fixed an issue where casting wouldn’t be cancelled and the casting bar would continuously appear if a character summoned a mount from the favorites list while moving.

[/olist]

[b] iv. Graphics / Location Bugs [/b]

[olist]

[*] Added a flight motion option to some ground mounts without a flight option.

[*] Fixed an issue where characters would get stuck in some locations in the Quarry District 3.

[*] Fixed an issue where movement would be blocked by a transparent object located in the Campagna Plains on The Commoners’ Residential Area stairs.

[*] Fixed an issue where the location or direction of some mount grade effects would be displayed incorrectly.

[/olist]

[b] v. Audio / Texts [/b]

[olist]

[*] Fixed some errors and inconsistencies in the audio and script.

[*] Modified some NPC’s facial motions to match their voices.

[*] Fixed some translation errors and inconsistencies.

[/olist]

[b] vi. Others [/b]

[olist]

[*] Fixed gameplay issues that would arise if a player clicked on certain buttons when playing with an XBOX controller. If an XBOX controller is connected, the movements will be disabled since the controller isn’t officially supported. 

[*] Fixed an issue where characters with overlapping names could not be deleted after the server transfer.

[/olist]

[h1] [Special Currency Shop] [/h1]

[olist]
[*] Added a new costume, pet, and mount to the Special Currency Shop.
- Costume - Pax Lumena Festival Pack (2600 Lumena)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/7a391029564010e8a202e3054478f562eb70b4d2.jpg[/img]

- Mount Costume - Prosperous Tallumi (1500 Lumena)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/bded48698beedbec00731b9f6dce860649db0fe0.jpg[/img]

- Pet Costume - Small Sun Pirio (1500 Lumena)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9035483a5ca24bb4992bcfeed9212ff52961cb9a.jpg[/img]

[/olist]

[h1] [Event] [/h1]

[olist]
[*] The Assassin Release Event will take place from August 8th to September 5th. Click [url=steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1701684721079337629] here [/url] for more info

[i] *The content in this patch note is subject to change during maintenance. The patch note will be updated in case of any changes. [/i]

[/olist]

notes.title: Level Up Event
notes.content:
We’ve planned a special leveling up event to celebrate the release of the Assassin class!
We hope you enjoy playing this stealthy new addition to the world of Bless.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4ef615b70b1e61fd0e42505a0798d8ab7642af44.jpg[/img]

[b][First Event] : Special Buff Event
[i]Event Duration: August 8th (after Maintenance) – September 5th (before Maintenance) [/i][/b]

During the event, players can get the following buffs which will allow their characters to level up more easily.
 
1. Assassin Buffs
[list]
[*]100% increase in EXP obtained through hunting
[*]50% decrease in repair costs
[/list]

2. Guardian / Paladin / Berserker / Mage /  Ranger Buffs
[list]
[*]50% increase in EXP obtained through hunting
[*]20% decrease in repair costs
[/list]

3. Note
Reduces Repair Costs Buff Event
- All Classes: Reduces Repair Costs by 20%
- Assassin Class: After reduces Repair Costs by 20% for classes, reduces Repair Costs by 37.5% additionally.

Ex) If Repair Cost is 100
- All Classes: Reduces Repair Costs by 20% so reduces Repair Costs to 80 gold.
- Assassin Class: The reduced price of 80 gold for repair costs applied to all classes will be additionally reduced by 37.5%, making the total reduced price 50 gold


[b][Second Event] : Get rewarded just for reaching certain levels with a new character!
[i]Event Duration: August 8th (after Maintenance) – September 5th (before Maintenance)[/i][/b]

[b]How to participate:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Get a special box just for creating a new character and logging in.
[*] Get various items just for reaching levels 10, 20, 30, 40 and 45.
[/olist]

[i][b]*Notes:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]You can obtain the Level 10 special box as the first reward. This box can only be opened when the character reaches Level 10.
[*]The Level 10 box contains the Level 20 box, the Level 20 box will contain the Level 30 box, and so on. All subsequent boxes can only be opened when the character reaches the appropriate level.
[*]Characters that were already created before the start of this event cannot participate.
[*]Your support box items will be retained after the event period.
[/list]

[b]Event Reward List:[/b]

[h1][Lv10] Support Box (Can be used after reaching Level 10)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gathering Bag (1 hour) (1)
[*]Pickaxe (1 hour) (1)
[*]Lesser Taming Scroll (10)
[*]Baguette (5)
[*]Mass Supply Lesser Health Potions (Moderate) (50)
[*]Magic Lucky Spirit Box (5)
[*][Lv20] Support Box
[/list]

[h1][Lv20] Support Box (Can be used after reaching Level 20)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gathering Bag (1 hour) (1)
[*]Pickaxe (1 hour) (1)
[*]Dwarf’s Magic Hammer (1 hour) (1)
[*]Golden Ratio Magical Powder (1 hour) (1)
[*]Magic Potential Blessing Powder (3)
[*]Condensed Magic Stone (50)
[*]Mass Supply Repair Kit (10)
[*]Peace Declaration (5)
[*][Lv30] Support Box
[/list]

[h1][Lv30] Support Box (Can be used after reaching Level 30)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Growth Elixir (1 hour) (5)
[*]Travel Companion Growth Potion (1 hour) (5)
[*]Organic Dry Feed (10)
[*]Organic Canned Food (10)
[*]Magic Pet Anima (5)
[*]Magic Mount Anima (5)
[*]Peace Declaration (5)
[*]50 Lumena
[*][Lv40] Support Box
[/list]

notes.title: [Update Preview] The Assassin, Siege of Castra, and Dominion Contract/Capital War
notes.content:
Hello, players of Bless Online!

With the August Assassin update only a few days away, we wanted to give you a look at what’s in store for you! In addition to the new class, the Siege of Castra and Dominion Contract/Capital War content will be available.

[b]Assassin Class[/b]

With this next big update coming August 8, we will be adding the Assassin class! Players of both factions will be able to play as the Assassin. On Hieron, the Habicht, Sylvan Elf, and Mascu can take on the role. On Union, the Amistad, Aqua Elf, Pantera, and Mascu are able to try their hands at assassination.

In addition to these faction and race options for the Assassin, players will be happy to know that the class is compatible with both action-targeting and tab-targeting combat modes.

This new class will have many fun new skills and stances for players to experience. Different stances encourage different styles of play, such as the Assassinate stance that increases damage dealt when the target is attacked from behind, or the Poison stance that deals additional damage to enemies afflicted with Poison or Venom! Each Assassin player will want to try a variety of tactics to see what they like the best.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a0b90d2a16f93d480975c54a59fe8e57fa290c9d.jpg[/img]
The recommended equipment for Assassins will be the dagger and either Light or Medium armor. For wearing armor suitable for their class, Assassins will get certain bonuses depending on how many pieces of suitable armor they are wearing and what level they are. For example, an Assassin above level 30 who is wearing all Light armor will get bonuses to Dodge Rate, Fighting Power, Critical Hit Damage, and Critical Hit Rate.


[b]Dominion Contract/Capital War[/b]

We’ll also be introducing Dominion Contract and Capital War! A Dominion Contract is a the contract that grants the authority to rule a specific territory within a faction. Dominion Contract bidding periods last for 40 minutes, and only guild leaders are able to place bids using Guild Influence. The guild leader that has the most Guild Influence wins the bid will become a Lord, and they and their guild will be eligible to participate in the Capital War. Those who lose the bid will get back 90% of the Guild Influence used in bidding.

Dominion Contract and Capital War will each be held once every two weeks, alternating every Saturday (for example, if the first and third Saturdays were Capital War days, then the second and fourth Saturdays in a month would have Dominion Contract instead). The times for Dominion Contract is as follows:
[list]
[*]NA: 18:00~18:40 (PDT)
[*]EU:21:00~21:40 (CEST)
[/list]

The available territories to bid on for Hieron are Lupuscana, Floren, Marta, Curia, and Ostium. The available territories for Union are Navarra, Migdal, Campagna, Terny, and Shaqqara.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/eba5b01b8a86e98675b6d5bbd4ea3564b094caa2.jpg[/img]
Guilds also earn a reward of 2000 Reign Points per territory won through a Dominion Contract bid, and they will earn 1000 Reign Points per day each day that they occupy a territory. While the territory is under their control, Guilds will also get additional benefits, and will be able to earn up to 3000 Reign Points per day depending on the amount of EXP, Combat Points, and Dungeon Points within the occupied territory.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8fcb180471e618bff4d46c723d0b40fa85159574.jpg[/img]
The Capital War is the battle that determines who holds the top rank of Protector Marshall or High Praetor, depending on the faction. 

Of course, only guilds that own territories are able to participate. These intense fights take place over the course of 45 minutes, during which time players must either protect or attack the important Guardian Statue. The guild that is able to both successfully attack and defend the statue is granted 20,000 Reign Points and other rewards such as temporary prestige mount costumes. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/0c6f71f8da044b21cc6eb8cf90e1926c78de39af.jpg[/img]
The schedule of Capital War is as follows:

[/list]

[i](Prestige mount High Praetor’s Authority)[/i]

[b]Siege of Castra[/b]

Players will also be able to experience the new large scale PvP content Siege of Castra during its scheduled times after this update! Capping at a maximum of 70v70, Siege of Castra will pit players of Hieron and Union factions against each other in a heated battle for victory. 

During Siege of Castra, players will fight to defeat the opposing faction’s Lord Commander within a 30 minute time limit. While players on both sides of the battle will earn Combat Points for participation, the winning side will be more heavily rewarded.

The Siege of Castra is scheduled to take place four times daily:

We hope to see you out there fighting for glory and honor soon!

Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] The Assassin, Siege of Castra, and More
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]

Hello to the Bless Online community!

We hope you have been enjoying your summer and the in-game Summer Camp Login Event as well. The next big thing on the horizon for us is the Assassin update that is slated for the second week of August. We know many of you have been asking about it and wanting to know more, so we decided that today we would share some of the things from that update that you have to look forward to. However, we don’t want to give everything away quite yet, so keep an eye out for more exclusive info the coming days!


[b]The Assassin Class[/b]

Assassins are masters of stealth and guile, so watch out; if you let your guard down you may find yourself poisoned, ambushed, or just quietly stabbed. Assassins are often focused on one thing and one thing only: the elimination of their target! If you allow one to sneak up behind you, you may not live to regret it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/234427aa44caf82e90ae1968c0d5216fd1a10884.jpg[/img]

Players of both factions will be able to play as the Assassin. On Hieron, the Habicht, Sylvan Elf, and Mascu can take on the role. On Union, the Amistad, Aqua Elf, Pantera, and Mascu are able to try their hands at assassination.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b626c74d308a506267f8a7e684fb5b21fada3a65.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9da8007cd2342c7e155acd3a286f62cd7b4aa6a9.jpg[/img]

In addition to these faction and race options for the Assassin, players will be happy to know that the class is compatible with both action-targeting and tab-targeting combat modes.


[b]Siege of Castra[/b]

The Assassin class isn’t the only exciting new thing that we will be adding in the update! Players will be able to experience the new large scale PvP content Siege of Castra during its scheduled times. Capping at a maximum of 70v70, Siege of Castra will pit players of Hieron and Union factions against each other in a heated battle for victory. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/a0f503d6d47af455849616602169058c5facf390.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/87748cfd1e85ca4b5b0069a19f76f64cde15715a.jpg[/img]

For more info about the Siege of Castra content, you can check out our previous post here: https://www.blessonline.net/news_read/133

[b]Dominion Contract/Capital War[/b]

We’ll also be introducing the Dominion Contract system and the Capital War! A Dominion Contract is a contract that grants the authority to rule a specific territory within a faction. Dominion Contract bidding periods last for 40 minutes, and guild leaders are able to place bids using Guild Influence. The guild leader that wins the bid will become a Lord, and they and their guild will be eligible to participate in the Capital War.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/8fcb180471e618bff4d46c723d0b40fa85159574.jpg[/img]

The Capital War is the battle that determines who holds the top rank of Protector Marshall or High Praetor, depending on the faction. During Capital War, players and guilds will be able to earn rewards for both victory and participation! We’ll have more information on those rewards soon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b250cd9fdbc6a6b64c825d5a65a9bc2a3082e4e9.jpg[/img]

Often in MMOs, it is difficult for new or small guilds to compete with bigger, more established ones. With Dominion Contract, we aim to give those smaller guilds a chance to compete on the same level as larger guilds, as everyone competes in point bidding rather than PvP (which would put guilds with less members at a disadvantage). During Capital War, smaller guilds are able to ally themselves with other guilds of their faction to achieve success!

As always, we can’t wait for you to try the update for yourself in August, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback on the new content. Remember to keep an eye out for our next Community Video and other posts for more info in the near future!

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: [Announcement] New Consolidated Server OPEN + Compensation Guide
notes.content:
Greetings!
Bless Online’s new consolidated servers are now open as server consolidation maintenance finished at 06:30 (PDT) July 25. Thank you for your patience.

[h1][Guide to the New Consolidated Servers][/h1]
Players can now connect to the new servers to verify their transferred character information. 
[list]
[*]NA[list]
[*]Tanara / Habicht / Sforza / Deblahyim were merged to form the new server [b][NA] Hilan[/b].
[*]Lilyanthes / Murabi / Chinuwa / Gagato were merged to form the new server [b][NA] Kairos[/b].
[/list]
[*]EU[list]
[*]Physis / KuatRan were merged to form the new server [b][EU] Bacillas[/b].
[*]Daimon / Ventus / Ermekis /  Baraka / Melacazeus were merged to form the new server [b][EU] Iriaphos[/b].
[/list]
[/list]

[h1][Server Consolidation Compensation][/h1]
[list]
[*]As compensation for the server consolidation maintenance, Premium Membership buffs that were active during the maintenance time will be extended by 24 hours. However, please be aware that [b]players must connect to the game within the 7 day period from July 25 (after maintenance is complete) to August 1st (08:30 PDT)[/b] to receive the buff extension.
[*][b]1,000 Lumena has been added to players’ account inboxes[/b] as an expression of our thanks to users who have waited for server consolidation.
[/list]

[h1][Recovery of Purchased Items][/h1]
[list]
[*]Items Purchased from the Special Currency Shop
[list]
[*]Items from the costume/ mount costume/ pet costume/ Extend Function categories of the Special Currency Shop, if owned by a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or character limit, were collected and converted into Lumena (amount equivalent to purchase price). The Lumena was then given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.
[/list]
[*]Inventory Slot and Character Slot Expansion Items
[list]
[*]Inventory Slot Expansion items and Character Slot Expansion items in inventories or storage that have yet been used [b]were collected and converted into Lumena (amount equivalent to purchase price). The Lumena was then given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.[/b]
[/list]
[*]Founder’s Packs, Lumena Packs, and Premium Memberships will be delivered to players’ account inboxes in turn.
[list]
[*]If characters that own Founder’s Packs, Lumena Packs, or Premium Memberships were deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or character limit, [b]the aforementioned items will be collected and delivered to the player’s account inbox as a package that excludes the Premium Membership Buffs and Lumena during server consolidation maintenance.[/b]
[*]As Premium Membership Buffs are applied account-wide, they do not need to be recovered. Lumena will be collected and recovered through a different method and is therefore excluded from the packages that will be delivered to the player’s inbox.
[*]Although we plan to deliver these items in turn during server consolidation maintenance, we also expect the delivery process to continue even after maintenance is over. Therefore we would like to ask for your understanding and patience in this matter.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1][i]*Note[/i][/h1]
[list]
[*]According to the above character preservation standards, some characters on servers to be consolidated may be deactivated after the opening of the new consolidated server.
[*]If a player would like to reactivate a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or character limit after server consolidation, then please contact our Customer Support. 
[i][b]※ Please decide carefully as faction changes can be made through our Customer Support only ONCE.[/b][/i] 
[*]If by any chance a guild leader character gets deactivated after the server consolidation maintenance, the guild will also be deactivated. Any guild member can contact Customer Support to request that the guild be reactivated by making one of the current guild members the guild leader. The criteria for selecting the new guild leader is as follows:  
[i] 
※ First priority - the character with the higher guild ranking 
※ Second priority - the character who joined the guild first
※ Third priority - the character that has logged in most recently within the last two weeks
[b]
※ If a guild has only one member (and that member is the guild leader and is deactivated), the guild will be deactivated and will not be recovered even if the guild leader character is restored. In order to prevent this, make sure to add at least one new member to any single person guilds and appoint the new member as a vice guild leader before the server consolidation maintenance takes place.[/b][/i] 
[*]Character names on a player’s friends list may be changed or deleted after server consolidation. Please double check when sending mail or gifts.
[*]Overlapping character names or guild names can be modified beginning July 24, after the server consolidation maintenance.
[*]If a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or character limit was a guild member, then the character will also be removed from the guild members list. 
[*]After server consolidation, players with with battle ranks (Command Class) will maintain the ranks assigned from previous servers until the next evaluation. 
[*]As ranks were recalculated during server maintenance, please be advised that those who applied for a battle rank promotion evaluation before server consolidation may not receive a separate system notification even if their rank promotion application failed. 
[list]
[*]During server consolidation, the battle ranks for those who have applied for a battle rank promotion in their old servers will be recalculated based on the applicant’s points.  
[*]Those who fail to obtain a battle rank promotion will not be notified by a system message. We as for your understanding in this matter and hope that there will not be any confusion.
[/list]
[/list]

For more detailed information regarding Server Consolidation Transference Policy, please refer to the link below.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1684792419450470707

Thank you,
The Bless Team
