notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] Upcoming Content and Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]
Greetings, dear Bless Online players!

The team has been working hard on addressing your pressing issues as well as bringing you new content. Next week on 7/18 you will get to experience the Migra Turis (Elite) content! Other changes and content will be coming very soon as well, and you can read a bit about it all below.

[h1]Upcoming Content and Changes[/h1]

[b]Migra Turis (Elite) Update[/b] (7/18)

We have added a new level of difficulty to Migra Turis, which comes along with new rewards! Amongst other adjustments, players will now have a chance to obtain a Level 45 Heroic weapon from defeating the final boss, Flamelord Fogas. 

[b]Dungeon Drop Rate Changes (Coming Soon)[/b]

We know you all have been asking for a change in the dungeon drop rates. So, sometime soon after the 7/18 update, we will be hugely increasing the drop rate by doubling it. Further adjustments may still be made to the drop rate after we hear your feedback on the changes, so please let us know after you’ve tried it out!

[b]Combat Targeting Mode Changes[/b] (Coming Soon)

Many of you have been asking to have the option to switch targeting mode for different classes. As such, we have been working to bring you more options. In the next change to the targeting mode options, you will be able to switch between modes with all classes except the Berzerker and Paladin, which will still be locked to action targeting and tab targeting respectively. As the Paladin needs to use tab targeting to effectively heal and the Berzerker skills were optimized for action targeting, we have not yet been able to give both mode options to these classes that resulted in a positive player experience. We will instead be adding a target tracking function for the Berzerker (and the other classes as well) that we think will address many of your issues.

[b]Balance Changes[/b] (Coming Soon)

One major focus for the balance changes is PvP. We are making adjustments to the classes in ways that we think will contribute to a better PvP experience. We look forward to hearing your feedback after you have tried out the changes, as balance is always an ongoing process.
We are also working on PvE balance to improve the feel of each class in group play; amongst other things, we are working on buffing the aggro-holding ability of the Guardian.

Though we are working to bring you this new content and new improvements, we are also still working to address other big issues that you have brought up, such as optimization and additional balance and bug fixes. We appreciate the feedback that you continue to give us, and will keep using it to make Bless Online even better as we move towards launch.

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: Actions taken on the recent hack issues
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/60d0d2914e26ffa486c84c0887b33eed222c9821.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

As we announced in our last Producer’s Letter on July 6th, we have a zero tolerance policy towards all types of hacks and exploits and will continue to take the appropriate measures to ban users abusing the game. Our CMs have also announced through Discord that BattlEye bans are  being enforced, starting last weekend.

We have been continuously communicating with BattlEye in order to implement a detection system that allows us to accurately track users who have used any illegal programs or modified any of the core game files. However, modifying .ini files to increase FPS will not cause players to be banned.

Thank you for your reports that help us to identify the current hacks in Bless Online. Please continue to report any hacks or cheats so they can be dealt with swiftly.

Players who use illegal programs have been permanently banned. Since July 3rd (PDT / CEST) when the hack detection was enabled, 161 people have been banned. Currently players who are banned by BattlEye will see a generic connection failed message, but we will fix this issue so that players can know whether the shutdown is due to Battleye ban or server connection fail.

We are committed to resolving hacking issues as quickly as possible in order to make Bless Online a cheat-free and fair game for everyone.

Thank you again for all the reports you’ve been sending to us; we will continue to consider all your suggestions and feedback as we work to keep improving Bless Online.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] Optimization and Player Hacking
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]
Greetings, dear Bless Online players!

We hope you have been enjoying the July 4th Update with the new end-game content Basel Gorge and the Royal Quests. We’re listening closely to your feedback on it as you explore the different aspects of this new area and new quests. We hope you like the Market improvements as well.

[b]Optimization[/b]

We know that optimization is a big question on the community’s collective mind right now, and know that many users are manually editing the .ini file in an effort to improve performance themselves. While we know that improving performance isn’t that simple, we also recognize that this altering of .ini files represents a greater issue, and we’re working to improve it. Our devs are in fact currently in the process of refining the settings so that players who don’t alter the .ini file can further customize the game to match their own needs through the game’s own settings menu.

In addition to this first step towards improved optimization, we are currently focused on looking for solutions and fixing the performance issues that are at the core of the community-made .ini file modifications. We have identified specific function problems in the UI manager and in level streaming, and we are working to delete unneeded files that were included in the game build (removing redundant output in region level boundaries, etc).

Aside from the improvements in the client, we are also continuously working on network-related problems and server stability as mentioned in our previous announcements. We will give updates on improvements as they continue to progress, and in order to find any potential root causes that we are currently unaware of, we plan to conduct stress tests in a separate test environment (Live Service X) sometime in July. 

[b]Hacking[/b]

In the recent days we have received many reports and have been made aware of certain hacks that players are using to gain an unfair advantage over others in the game. This is absolutely against our terms of service, and we have already been taking immediate action against hackers. 

In addition to working on our own to track down and take action against hacking, exploiting, botting issues, and more, we greatly appreciate your reports to us of these issues. Sharing videos with us that contain character names and server info is extremely helpful and allows us to take the quickest and most accurate measures to address the problem. 

Using such tools and modifying the client are clearly methods of cheating; this is not a grey or unclear area. As such, we are issuing permanent bans to those who are or have been abusing these hacks. It is important to us that players are who aren’t using hacks are able to enjoy the Bless experience fully, and we believe these actions are towards that goal.


Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: Update Preview - Royal Quests and Basel Gorge
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 

The team has been busy working on the next update to Bless Online, and today we wanted to spend some time talking about that update (v1.3.0.0) as it will be released on July 4th! The focus of this update is new end-game content: Royal Quests and Basel Gorge.

[b]Royal Quests[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/10477c2f03dd6ea3e82352b50a8788aa3bfd84bc.jpg[/img]
Royal Quests are a new daily quest series that will be available to characters starting at level 45. Players will be able to find an accept these quests in multiple locations around the world; they will be marked by purple quest icons on the world map. Players will be able to complete a total of 15 Royal Quests per day to get the most rewards possible.

These quests have better rewards than regular quests! Not only does each Royal Quest have a higher gold reward than a normal quest, but for every 5 Royal Quests completed each day, players will receive an additional bonus reward via in-game mail. 

[table]
[tr]
[th]Royal Quest completed 5 times[/th]
[th][Luxury] Royal Box × 1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Royal Quest completed 10 times[/th]
[th][Rare] Royal Box × 1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Royal Quest completed 15 times[/th]
[th][Hero] Royal Box × 1[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

The top tier [Hero] Royal Box even has a small chance of dropping rare pets and mounts.

[b]Basel Gorge[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/48dd85b85938416c536359063bfce5cc62965519.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4188036341038178c88f52a763222bf9d653ab47.jpg[/img]
Basel Gorge is the highly contested centerpoint of the conflict between the Union and Hieron factions. As such, it is recommended that players approach Basel Gorge with a party of level 45 characters.

Located to the east of where the Siege of Castra takes place, Basel Gorge has many different gameplay elements for players to participate in. There are two main objectives to compete for with the opposing faction; controlling the three neutral bases and killing the various bosses in the Basel Gorge area. 

While in Basel Gorge, players are able to gain more Combat Points from engaging in PvP than they would in other open world zones by controlling neutral bases. Gaining control of a neutral base will grant all members of that faction currently in Basel Gorge a “Gorge Occupier” buff. 
This buff can stack up to three times, once for each neutral base in the area. Each stacked buff grants a 7% increase in movement speed and increases the amount of Combat Points gained from killing another player by 50%, making faction PvP within Basel Gorge extra rewarding. 

However, keep a close eye on the bases! Once a base is captured, it will only belong to that faction for twenty minutes before it reverts to neutral and can be contested by the opposing faction once again.

Basel Gorge is laid out with Hieron in the north and Union in the south. There are also various teleporters and revive points for each faction spread throughout the map. Bosses spawn towards the middle of the area, with some spawn locations being more easily contested by one faction than the other.

The bosses players will find in Basel Gorge are more difficult than the typical elite bosses that are spread across the world of Bless. There are also three different rarities of bosses, determined by their respawn time and the randomness of their spawn location. Sak the Hobgoblin Fiend and Murderous Rover Sykeeli are the most common; they are on short respawn timers and will spawn at predictable locations throughout the map. Ensanguined Ursuta and the Giant Malefic Blob are on a slightly longer respawn timer and will appear in one of seven random locations around the map. Last, but certainly not least, Spider Queen Akasys—one of the most challenging bosses in Basel Gorge—is on the longest spawn timer and will appear in one of seven random locations when she spawns.

Loot in Basel Gorge works differently than it does in other areas in Bless. Participation in the fight for each boss is calculated to determine the overall contribution of each person in the fight. The more a player participates in each fight, the more Combat Points they will be awarded for defeating the boss. Remember that in Basel Gorge, players are always competing against the opposing faction for credit on boss kills. Loot drops will be distributed via die roll for the faction that successfully takes down the boss.

As you can see, there are many ways to enjoy the new Basel Gorge content. Players can choose to fight difficult bosses, attack bases, defeat members of the opposing faction—or even a combination of the three! We hope you all have as much fun with this new content as we do, and we look forward to hearing your feedback on it.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer's Letter] The July 4th Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dear Bless Online players!

The focus of today’s letter is new content, changes and improvements that we will be bringing to you in Bless Online very soon. The team has been working hard on things for future updates, and we wanted to share a bit about them with you.

[h1]The July 4th Update Content (v1.3.0.0)[/h1]

We have heard all of your feedback that you would like to see more activities and content added for the end-game, and this update will do just that! We will be adding Royal Quests and Basel Gorge for your enjoyment. 

[b]Royal Quests[/b]

Royal Quests are a new daily quest series that will be available to characters starting at level 45. Players will be able to find and accept these quests in multiple locations around the world; they will be marked by purple quest icons on the world map. Players will be able to complete a total of 15 Royal Quests per day to maximize their rewards—which we think they will want to do since these quests have better rewards than regular quests. Some of the possible rewards even include rare pets and mounts!

[b]Basel Gorge[/b]

Basal Gorge is the crux of the conflict between the Union and Hieron factions. As such, it is recommended that Basel Gorge be approached with a party of level 45 players.

Located to the east of where the Siege of Castra takes place, Basel Gorge has a wide variety of gameplay elements that players can take part in, including difficult bosses to take down (Spider Queen Akasys, Murderous Rover Sykeeli, and more), enemy bases to attack, and enemy troops to battle. With options for many kinds of play within Basel Gorge, we hope that all high-level players are able to enjoy this area as much as we do.

You can look forward to more details about Basel Gorge and Royal Quests being shared soon!

[h1]Market Improvements[/h1]

In addition to this new content, we are also going to be making some adjustments to improve the Market with the update on July 4th. We received your feedback that the Market was not functioning in the way that either you wanted or we intended, so we are making some changes to its functionality. Please let us know what you think of these changes once they have been implemented.

[b]Changes in the Market[/b]

Our goal with these changes is to prevent players from having difficulty using or from being unable to use the Market due to issues with item prices being raised to values that most players can’t afford to pay. We already implemented a first step in these changes on June 26nd which you can read about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1684792325780524895] here. [/url]

We have adjusted some of the standard prices of certain items that have been abnormally changed, and temporarily locked them so as to reach stability in the Market. We also temporarily increased the range of the minimum/maximum registration price and will leave it that way until the Market balance is improved.

[b]UI[/b]

In addition, we will also be making some improvements to the Market UI to make it more user friendly, and plan to display additional information about transactions that have been made and make other modifications to the UI according to the system changes.

We have even more updates planned for the near future, so stay tuned! We’re also still working on many improvements stemming from your feedback on balance, performance, bugs, and more. We look forward to hearing your feedback on these new changes and content.

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: Bless Server Consolidation Guide and Policy
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4d80b1d791c36a16d4e019dc46bdbf600279c590.jpg[/img]

Greetings!
As mentioned in our last Producer’s Letter, we will be consolidating our servers on July 24 (PDT). The details are as follows. 
 
[h1][b] [Server Consolidation Schedule and Guide] [/b][/h1]
[b]* Server Consolidation Schedule: July 24, 2018 (PDT) (Time: TBA)[/b]
[b]* Who will be affected?[/b]
Characters that were created before the expected maintenance on July 24 will be transferred to the new consolidated servers. Enjoy Bless in a new environment!

[list]
[*] NA
Tanara / Habicht / Sforza / Deblahyim will be merged to form the new server [b][NA] Hilan.[/b]
Lilyanthes / Murabi / Chinuwa / Gagato will be merged to form the new server [b][NA] Kairos.[/b]

[*] EU
Physis / KuatRan will be merged to form the new server [b][EU] Bacillas.[/b]
Daimon / Ventus / Ermekis /  Baraka / Melacazeus will be merged to form the new server [b][EU] Iriaphos.[/b]
[/list]

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Region[/th]
	[th]Servers to be Consolidated[/th]
	[th]New Consolidated Server[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]NA[/td]
	[td]Tanara
Habicht
Sforza
Deblahyim[/td]
	[td][NA] Hilan[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]NA[/td]
	[td]Lilyanthes
Murabi[/td]
	[td][NA] Kairos[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]EU[/td]

KuatRan[/td]
	[td][EU] Bacillas[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]EU[/td]
	[td]Daimon
Ventus
Ermekis
Baraka
Melacazeus[/td]
	[td][EU] Iriaphos[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]


[h1][b][Transference of Character Information][/b][/h1]
All character information will be transferred securely. However, if there are any faction clashes (if a player has characters from both the Hieron or Union faction) or if there are insufficient character slots for the amount of characters possessed, then some characters may be deactivated according to the priority guidelines below. 

[b]If there is no discrepancy between the characters’ factions and there are enough slots for all characters on an account, then rest assured that all character information will be transferred securely. [/b]

[olist]
[*] [b] What if I have characters from different factions? [/b]
As the Bless world is based on the conflicting Hieron and Union factions, players cannot create characters of both the Hieron and Union faction on the same server.

Therefore, if an account has both Hieron and Union characters on servers that will be consolidated, only one faction’s characters will be transferred and the other will be deactivated. The process for determining which faction’s characters will remain and which will be deactivated will be based on the following character preservation priority standards. The opposing faction’s characters will automatically be deactivated. 

(Deactivation does not mean that your character information will be deleted. Although the character will not be shown on the character selection window, Neowiz will continue to store the character’s information. If the player would like to have their other faction’s character information preserved, and it happens to be eligible for restoration under Neowiz’s policy, then the player may request the reactivation of the inactive faction’s character information and deactivate the opposite faction’s character.)

[list]
[*] Priority Guidelines for when a player has characters of opposing factions

[b]First Priority:[/b] Guild leader characters
[b]Second Priority:[/b] High level characters
[b]Third Priority:[/b] Most recently used character

If an account has a character that is a guild leader, we will prioritize preserving characters that are in the same faction as the guild leader character. If there is no guild leader character, the next priority will be high level characters, and lastly, the most recently played character. The faction to be preserved will be decided using the above standards.

*Guild leaders are prioritized because a guild’s information will also be deleted if its guild leader is deleted, thereby affecting not only the guild leader but all guild members. 
[/list]

[*] [b] What if I have characters from different factions? [/b]
All accounts come with at least 4 character slots. 2 more can be purchased for a total of 6. If an account has more characters than character slots, the characters to be transferred will be determined based on the below character preservation priority standard and the amount of character slots a player has. 

[b]First Priority:[/b] Guild leaders characters
[b]Second Priority:[/b] High level characters
[b]Third Priority:[/b] Most recently used character

For example, if a player did not purchase extra character slots on the servers to be consolidated, then only a max of 4 character slots will be available. As a result, only 4 characters will be transferred according to the above character preservation standard. All other characters aside from the 4 will be deactivated. (There is no problem if you have less characters than the amount of slots owned.)

[*] [b] What if someone has the same character name? [/b]
If another character has the same character name within the servers to be consolidated, then your character name will be changed temporarily. 

[b]First Priority:[/b] Characters which were created before this Server Consolidation Announcement (June 26), and which were used to play the game between the announcement period and the actual server consolidation maintenance date.

[list]
[*]If the other character with the same name did not connect to the game during the period between the announcement period and the actual server consolidation maintenance date, then the character name will be maintained. 
[*]If the other character with the same name did connect to the game during the period between the announcement and the actual server consolidation maintenance date, then the player’s character name will be changed temporarily. Once connected to the new consolidated server, the player will be required to rename their character in order to proceed.
[/list]

[b]Second Priority:[/b] Characters created after this Server Consolidation Announcement (June 26)
[list]
[*] Between a character created before this announcement and one created after, the name of the one created before will be maintained if their character names overlap.
[*] The character will be given a temporary name (number_original name), and ONE chance to change the character name upon connecting to the server after consolidation. 
[*] Renaming characters on the new server will be conducted on a first-come first-serve basis. Players will need to act quickly in order to get their desired name. 
[*] Players will not be able to connect to the game if overlapping names are not changed after server consolidation.
[/list]

[*][b] What if another guild has the same guild name?[/b]
If two guilds have the same name, the following priority naming standard will be applied.

[b]First Priority:[/b] The name of the higher level guild will be preserved.
[b]Second Priority:[/b] If the guild levels are the same, the guild that was created earlier will have their name preserved.
[b]Third Priority:[/b] If both of the standards above are not applicable, then temporary names in the format of “Number_Guild Name” will be assigned.

[h1] ※ Guilds that were give temporary guild names can be changed once the guild leader character connects to the game. [/h1]

[*][b] Gold[/b]
As gold is bound to the server, all gold from servers to be consolidated will be combined and made usable on the new server. In other words, if a player has 1 Gold on server A, and 2 Gold on server B, then the player will now have 3 Gold on the new server. 

[*][b] Using the Market[/b]
As the market system of registering and purchasing items is account based, players can continue to register and purchase items from the marketplace regardless of character name changes. 

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Transference Information[/th]
	[th]Transference Standard[/th]
	[th]Priority Standards and Details[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]1. Preservation Standard according to Character’s Faction[/td]
	[td]1) Characters on the servers to be consolidated are all from the same faction

2) Characters on the servers to be consolidated are members of different factions [/td]
	[td]1-1)
* All characters of the same faction will be combined in the new server. 
(However, the amount of characters transferred will differ depending on the amount of character slots available. Refer to section 2 of Transference Information).

2-1)
*If a player has characters from both factions on servers to be consolidated, then the characters and faction to be preserved will be determined according to the below Priority Standards. 
[list]
[*]First Priority: Guild leader characters
[*]Second Priority: High level characters
[*]Third Priority: Most recently used character
[/list]
(However, the amount of characters transferred will differ depending on the amount of character slots available. Refer to section 2 of Transference Information).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]2. Character Transference Standard according to the amount of character slots owned[/td]
	[td]1) Total amount of characters owned do not exceed the amount of character slots owned.

2) Total amount of characters owned exceeds the amount of character slots owned[/td]
	[td]1-1)
*All characters will be transferred to the new server according to the amount of character slots owned. 
*The amount of characters transferred will depend on how many character slots were purchased (if any). 

2-1)
* The amount of purchased character slots on servers to be consolidated will be combined and totaled. A max of 2 purchase character slots will be applied to the new server, but if the total amount of purchased character slots exceeds 2 then the exceeding amount will be converted to Lumena that will be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]3. Name Preservation Standard for when two characters have the same name[/td]
	[td]1) No other character has the same name
2) Two characters have the same name[/td]
	[td]1-1) Character name is preserved.

2-1)
* The character will be given a temporary character name according to the following Preservation Priority Standard. 
* Temporary character names must be changed upon connecting to the new server before you may begin the name.
First Priority: Characters which were created before this Server Consolidation Announcement (June 26), and which were used to play the game between the announcement date and the actual server consolidation maintenance date.
Second Priority: Characters created after this Server Consolidation Announcement (June 26).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]4. Name Preservation Standard for when two guilds have the same name[/td]
	[td]1) No other guild has the same name
2) Two guilds share the same guild name[/td]
	[td]1-1)
Guild name is preserved.

2-1)
*Guilds with overlapping names that are not resolved under First Priority or Second Priority (listed below) will have temporary names in the format of “Guild Name + Number” assigned. 
*Temporary guild names can be changed once the guild leader character connects to the game.
[list]
[*] First Priority: The name of the higher level guild will be preserved.
[*] Second Priority: The name of the guild that has been around longer will be preserved.
[list]
 If a guild that was created after this Server Consolidation Announcement (June 26)  shares the same name as one created before, it will be given a temporary name.
[/list]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]5. Gold[/td]
	[td]All gold from servers to be consolidated will be combined and made usable on the new server (Gold from the deactivated faction will also be included).[/td]
	[td][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]6. Using the Market[/td]
	[td]As the market system of registering and purchasing items is account based, players can use a different character on the same account to retrieve items put on the market before server consolidation.[/td]
	[td][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[*][b]Transference and Recovery of Purchased Items[/b]
[list]
[*][b] a) Purchased Character Slots [/b]
The amount of purchased character slots on all applicable servers will be totaled and combined. 

- Case 1: If there is only 1 purchased character slot on the applicable servers, the player will now have a total of 5 character slots (4 free + 1 purchased) available for use on the new server.

- Case 2: If the total amount of purchased character slots exceeds 2, the exceeding amount will be converted to Lumena. The Lumena will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.  

- Case 3: If the purchased character slot(s) is associated with a faction that has been deactivated in accordance with the above character preservation priority standards, then the purchased slot will automatically be transferred to the remaining active faction. However, if the total amount of purchased character slots exceeds 2, the exceeding amount will be converted to Lumena. The Lumena will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.    

[*][b] b) Purchased Inventory Slots[/b]
A character’s active inventory slots will be transferred as is. However, the expanded inventory of a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters will be converted to Lumena. The Lumena will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.  

[*][b] c) Lumena [/b]
All of a character’s Lumena will be transferred. However, the Lumena possessed by a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters will be collected and given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.  

[*][b] d) Purchased Items [/b]

[list]
[*] Founder’s Pack and Premium Membership Items
If characters with a Founder’s Pack or Premium Membership items are deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters, the concerning items (excluding Premium Membership Buffs and Lumena) will be collected and delivered to the player’s account inbox during server consolidation maintenance. 

※ As Premium Membership Buffs are applied account-wide they are not eligible for recovery. 
※ Lumena will be collected and recovered through a different method and is therefore excluded from the packages that will be delivered to the player’s inbox. 

[*] Lumena Pack Items
Lumena Packs that were purchased but kept as items in the inventory (Lumena that has not yet been applied to a character) of characters that are deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters will be collected and delivered to the player’s account inbox during server consolidation maintenance. 
[/list]

[*][b] e) Special Currency Shop [/b]
Items from the costume/ mount costume/ pet costume/ Extend Function categories of the Special Currency Shop, if owned by a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters, will be collected and converted into Lumena (matching the purchase price), and will then be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.

Items that are not from the costume / mount costume / pet costume / Extend Function categories are considered consumables or items with expiration dates/times and will not be recovered or compensated. 
[/list]

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Transference Information[/th]
	[th]Transference Standard[/th]
	[th]Priority Standards and Details[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]a) Purchased Character Slots[/td]
	[td]1) Less than 2 purchased character slots

2) More than 2 purchased character slots[/td]
	[td]1-1) They will be totaled and combined.

2-1) Exceeding slots will be converted to Lumena and given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]b) Purchased Inventory Slots[/td]
	[td]1) There are no purchased inventory slots on deactivated characters 

2) The deactivated character has purchased inventory slots[/td]
	[td]1-1) Inventory slots currently activated on each character will be transferred as is. 

2-1) Exceeding slots will be converted to Lumena and given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server. 
Inventory slots that were received as quest rewards will not be converted to Lumena.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]c) Lumena[/td]
	[td]1) If there are no deactivated characters

2) Some characters are deactivated[/td]
	[td]1-1) All of a character’s Lumena information will be transferred as is.

2-1) The Lumena owned by a deactivated character will be collected and added to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]d) Lumena Packs[/td]
	[td]1) The character that owns these items is active

2) The character that has unused Lumena Packs in their inventory or mailbox has been deactivated [/td]
	[td]1-1) Item information will be transferred as is.

2-1) If the items are owned by a deactivated character, they will be collected and re-sent to the player’s account inbox.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]e) Founder’s Pack[/td]
	[td]1) The character that owns these items is active

2) The character that has unused Founder’s Pack items in their inventory or mailbox has been deactivated[/td]
	[td]1-1) Item information will be transferred as is.

2-1) If the items are owned by a deactivated character, they will be collected and re-sent to the player’s account inbox (this package will exclude Lumena and Premium buffs, as Lumena will be recovered in a different way, and Premium Buffs are applied account-wide and not eligible for recovery).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]f) Premium Membership[/td]
	[td]1) The character that owns these items is active

2) The character that owns these items has been deactivated [/td]
	[td]1-1) Item information will be transferred as is.

2-1) As Premium Buffs are applied account wide, they don’t need to be transferred between characters. Premium Memberships will be collected and redelivered to the player’s account inbox.  [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]g) Items Purchased from the Special Currency Shop[/td]
	[td]1) The character that owns these items is active

2) The character that has these items in their inventory has been deactivated [/td]
	[td]1-1) Item information will be transferred as is.

2-1) Special Currency Shop items from the costume / mount costume / pet costume / Extend Function categories will be collected and converted to Lumena that will be given to the player’s character with the highest level on the new server (All items that are not from the costume / mount costume / pet costume / Extend Function categories are considered consumables or items with expiration dates/times and will not be recovered or compensated).[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[/olist]

[h1][b] *Note [/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] According to the above character preservation standards, some characters on servers to be consolidated may be deactivated after the opening of the new consolidated server.

[*] If a player would like to reactivate a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters after server consolidation, then please contact our Customer Support.
[h1] ※ Please decide carefully as faction changes can be made through our Customer Support only ONCE. [/h1]

[*] If by any chance a guild leader character gets deactivated after the server consolidation maintenance, the guild will also be deactivated. Any guild member can contact Customer Support to request that the guild be reactivated by making one of the current guild members the guild leader. The criteria for selecting the new guild leader is as follows:  

※ First priority - the character with the higher guild ranking 
※ Second priority - the character who joined the guild first
※ Third priority - the character that has logged in most recently within the last two weeks
[h1] ※ If a guild has only one member (and that member is the guild leader and is deactivated), the guild will be deactivated and will not be recovered even if the guild leader character is restored. In order to prevent this, make sure to add at least one new member to any single person guilds and appoint the new member as a vice guild leader before the server consolidation maintenance takes place.
[/h1]

[*]Character names on a player’s friends list may be changed or deleted after server consolidation. Please double check when sending mail or gifts.

[*]Overlapping character names or guild names can be modified beginning July 24, after the server consolidation maintenance.

[*][h1] If a character that was deactivated due to either faction incompatibility or having too many characters was a guild member, then the character will also be removed from the guild members list.  [/h1]
[/list]

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Producer's Letter] Early Access Week 3 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b4ebfd96e1099f27ae7ceee4a68e6c65f6c1328d.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

In today’s letter we are going to mainly talk about servers; first about the stability issues that we encountered during the start of Bless Online’s Early Access, and second about the upcoming server consolidation.


[b]Server Stability During the Start of Early Access[/b]

When preparing to launch Bless in Early Access on Steam, we decided to use AWS for our servers based on our previous experience using it for 5+ years. We automated infrastructure configuration and server extensions, and from six months ago we tested AWS to verify server stability at varying levels of server load.
 
When Bless Online Early Access launched, the servers were initially able to provide stable service, and were supposed to be able to support up to 5000 CCU each. However, after a period of time, a problem developed with network connectivity, which posed a threat to service stability. Because of this, we opted to increase our total servers temporarily to help balance out the amount of players.

Immediately we began working to track down the root of the issue, and were able to ascertain that the problem was stemming from the ENA (Elastic Network Adapter) feature of AWS. We were able to address this issue by switching all server instance types to a previous generation that didn’t use ENA, and server stability has since increased. However, we will continue to collaborate with AWS to try and continually improve the reliability and performance of the Bless servers.


[b]Server Consolidation[/b]

Now that Early Access launch is over, in the coming weeks it will be time to consolidate the servers that we temporarily opened up to account for the influx of new players trying out the game. However, we will have servers ready and waiting for Bless Online’s full launch when we’ll need the space once again! Before the consolidations take place (we are currently aiming for the end of July), we will share with you all a detailed guide on how they will work. For now, here is an overview of the changes.

We will be consolidating into 2 NA servers and 2 EU servers; the remaining NA servers will be Kairos and Hilan, and the EU servers will be Bacillas and Iriaphos. The rest of the servers will be consolidated into these.

Before the consolidations are implemented, there will be a period of time where players will be able to prepare themselves for the consolidations. With the guide that we will provide at a later date closer to the consolidation, players will be able to plan ahead with their characters and know where they will be going, what items will be transferred where, and more. Additionally, after the consolidations take place, we are planning on adding the 70v70 Siege of Castra mode that you may have seen the preview for a couple weeks ago. 

We have heard many of you giving feedback and asking about server consolidations, and we hope that you will enjoy your experience in Bless even more after these changes have been made! As always, we will be working with AWS and our own engineers to provide stable, enjoyable servers for all our players.


[b]The 6/21 Game Update[/b]

On 6/21, we released a game update to address some of the balance issues with classes, which included reducing the frequency of the Paladin’s ability to use CC, buffing the ranger, and improving the Berserker’s DPS. You can read in detail about the changes in the patch notes here: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1684791781097199072]v1.2.0.0 Patch Note[/url] 

Please let us know what you think of these balance changes! We are working on other important issues such as dungeon balance, improved performance, Auction House functionality, and more. However, we hope you can enjoy this balance patch while we continue to make the Bless experience even better, and keep an eye out for more updates soon! 

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: [Producer’s Letter] What Early Access Means to Us and a Look to the Future
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]

Hello, dearest Bless Online players!

When we decided to bring the world of Bless to Steam, we didn’t want to just localize or translate the game we already had launched in other regions. We knew that it had to be something more. With the western version of Bless Online, we knew we had a chance to take things back to the proverbial drawing board, and try to make this passion project even better than ever before. 

However, we also knew that we needed help to achieve this goal. We needed people to play Bless, to give us feedback on our design changes, and to tell us what worked and what didn’t. We knew that we’d been making Bless for so long that if it was ever going to come out in the West, it needed to be different from all our previous releases. 

Ultimately, this desire to try something new with the systems of Bless Online combined with the need for an open discussion with our player base led us to Steam’s Early Access platform. It allows us to make sure we have the funds to continue supporting Bless, while also working directly with our players to make Bless everything it can be and more. Steam’s own description of Early Access fits what we’re trying to achieve quite well:

“We like to think of games and game development as services that grow and evolve with the involvement of customers and the community. There have been a number of prominent titles that have embraced this model of development recently and found a lot of value in the process. We like to support and encourage developers who want to ship early, involve customers, and build lasting relationships that help everyone make better games.”

Where we are today with Bless Online’s Steam Early Access is not where we will be when the game officially launches in the coming months. As you hopefully have seen, we’ve been hard at work addressing feedback, making changes, fixing bugs, and working to make the best game for both Neowiz Bless Studio and our fans. Bless has always been a passion project for everyone at Neowiz, and the sheer amount of support and care we’ve received in response to the game has been overwhelming.

So while Early Access is just the beginning for Bless Online, we wanted to lay some details on you for what’s to come over the next several months.

PLEASE REMEMBER THAT THIS LIST IS NOT SET IN STONE! All dates are subject to change, and more details on future content updates are still forthcoming. Right now, this is the expected flow of content, and of course these updates will also bring new fixes, balance changes, and quality of life improvements. We will have much more info on each of the new content pieces as we get closer to their release.

Localization is still in progress for both English and German. But what about game systems and content? Glad you asked! Take a look at some of what we have planned below, in no specific order:

3v3 Arena: Small group faction PvP content.
Game Balance Adjustment
Basel Valley : Level 45 elite field boss. 3 or more party members recommended.
Royal Quest: Level 45 royal quests throughout the Bless world. 
New Elite Dungeon 
Action & Tab-targeting 
Siege of Castra: 70v70 massive PvP content. 

We hope this gives you a good outline of what to expect in the coming months. We will of course be hosting live events, adding other systems as they become available (such as the action camera on other classes besides Berzerker), and tweaking gameplay and content as needed to make Bless the best it can possibly be.

We truly appreciate you taking this journey with us, and we can’t wait to see where we go from here.

Always at your service,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: [Producer's Letter] Early Access Week 1 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/20a8bc20090a2a69f38e8dd910986586ee1b47df.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

It has been over a week since Bless Online's Early Access began, and the whole Bless Team including developers, customer support, and community have been very busy. We are also very thankful for all your feedback in the form of bugs, suggestions, and more. 

As we encountered various issues shortly after our first server opened, we did our best to address the situation and come up with solutions to implement as quickly as we could. 

However, as important as it is quickly solve individual issues, it is also important to share the current and future milestones of Bless Online with you so that we are all on the same page. We will continue to communicate with the community in order to improve our game all the way up to our official release. I will also continue to use the format of the Producer’s Letter to discuss Bless Online during Early Access.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/76475de5e28d8e956e69e8dfd8d5ac58f1b33942.jpg[/img]
First of all, we have reviewed all of your feedback regarding server stabilization, localization, monetization, game content, and more. As a result, we found that the biggest issues were server stabilization, client optimization and game content adjustments that differ from our originally intended game design. 

Last week, we updated the game with multiple patches for improved server stabilization and bug fixes. We plan to continue improving server stability in addition to catching any critical errors.
[quote]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264230347956496]v1.0.0.1 Patch Note[/url]: EA release specification
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264230350595935]v1.0.0.2 Patch Note[/url]: Quest item respawn time adjustment for smoother quest progression and bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683467427454]v1.0.0.3 Patch Note[/url]: Loading screen freeze fix and 5 other bugs fixes 
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683478321637]v1.0.0.4 Patch Note[/url]: Peninsula War update, first game balance adjustment and 5 other bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683485271253]v1.0.0.5 Patch Note[/url]: Quest tracker issue hotfix
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683490362953]v1.0.0.6 Patch Note[/url]: Peninsula War buff deletion issue hotfix
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683492670644]v1.0.0.7 Patch Note[/url]: Berserker stance skill issue hotfix
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1653264683503492995]v1.0.0.8 Patch Note[/url]: second game balance adjustment, appearance change item with gender change, and 3 other bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1652139417423215149]v1.0.0.9 Patch Note[/url]: Fixed the NPC store selling price of a specific item and 3 other bug fixes
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1652139417430110904]v1.0.1.0 Patch Note[/url]: Changes to Chain Bonus interruptions, field boss drop-table, and 6 other bug fixes
[/list]
[/quote]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/c38d0412c8643a7ffff1b95d43cbd3743155588d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]1. Localization (L10N)[/b][/h1]
We are aware and agree with the community’s criticism regarding the poor quality of current localization. I’d like to inform you that the completion rate of the main storyline’s localization process is over 90%. However, just before EA, we realized that there were some serious localization errors in newly developed areas such as the tutorial, skills, and system messages, all of which could be found early on in the Steam version of the game. As a result, we decided put a stop to all localization projects and focus on language QA. 

We have improved the localization process and assigned dedicated personnel to the L10N team for higher quality results. We plan to improve and finalize the English text before starting to translate the English text into German. 

Below are some changes made to the live server last week. 
[quote]
[list]
[*]Corrected mistranslations in the NPC script
[*]Corrected mistranslations of skill names and synced all the UI terms (still work in progress)
[*]Corrected the level up phrase
[*]Corrected faction mistranslations in character creation
[*]Synced the terms found in the Spirit and Gear Score UI
[/list][/quote]
Our top priority right now is to increase the quality of the English translations and to eliminate player confusion caused by poorly translated text. As mistranslations can be patched without server maintenance, we will apply the new edited files to the client to as soon as they are available to  improve the quality of the translation.

[h1][b]2. Customer Support ticket delays[/b][/h1]
We unfortunately did not prepare enough infrastructure support or service personnel to meet the demands of players at the launch of Bless Online. The amount of inquiries and requests received through our customer support channel and Discord, and other channels was many  times more than what our customer service and community team could handle. We are well aware of this issue and are treating it with utmost importance. In order to quickly respond to the tickets, we have temporarily recruited customer support staff from other Neowiz projects.  For improved service in the long run, we are adding more dedicated staff to the team. We expect our speed of response rate to increase and normalize soon. 

[h1][b]3. Server performance improvements and game optimizations[/b][/h1]
Last week, we encountered serious issues that affected game connectivity and progression such as the loading screen freezing, server crashes, queues, and in-game delays. As a result, we carried out various performance improvements to solve these issues. 
[quote]
[list]
[*]Installed new servers without maintenance (there are currently 6 NA and 5 EU top-level servers).
[*]Upgraded the DB systems/storage to high-performance equipments to solve in-game delays.
[*]Increased cloud server capacity to solve queue issues.
[*]Improved stability by tuning server-to-server network connectivity.
[*]Switched to the previous generation AWS instance type to solve the network interface problems introduced by the latest AWS instance type.
[/list][/quote]
Our development team is currently looking for additional ways to improve performance, and will continue the optimization work through consistent monitoring and analysis. 


In addition to our original patch schedule, we are working hard to update our live servers right away every time a fix is prepared. As with scheduled patches, we aim to share detailed information through patch notes for each and every update. 

In addition to bug fixes and game optimization, we are also working to add new content ahead of schedule for players to enjoy.
Soon we'll be updating Bless with the “Siege of Castra” battlefield that was introduced in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460487597/announcements/detail/1652139417423239914][EA Update Preview #2 - Siege of Castra][/url]. We look forward to receiving your feedback on the new content when it becomes available, and I wish you all victory on the battlefield. 

Sincerely,
Sungjin Ko, Executive Producer

notes.title: EA Update Preview #2 - Siege of Castra
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/55074d08960f1af82b7fce7b5fce2a7917320a98.jpg[/img]


Greetings! 

Following the Peninsular War, we are excited to introduce more new updates! The Siege of Castra, a large-scale battlefield that pitches a max of 70 players from each faction (140 in total!) against each other will be available to players soon. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9c0f46c561f83dfbda6d3be251fbcab220d2dc26.jpg[/img]

Players above level 25 will be able to participate in the Siege of Castra by going to their System Menu (ESC)>  War (B)> Battlefield List. Once players have entered the battlefield, they will be able to prepare for the official start of the war in either the Hieron or the Union military headquarters.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/919aeddf23c00df00b72a91ee50d1cbc8cf9ad69.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5b73b83a95ad6c61c743cff977478a1d3419cba4.jpg[/img]

The war lasts for 30 minutes, and victory can be achieved by defeating the enemy commander who is located in the opposing faction’s military headquarters. However, it is not easy to infiltrate each faction's fortress. (If neither side is able to eliminate the opposing faction’s commander, the war will end in a tie.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/67928c56aa7e9c2dc4672d62817a8f11ce7add9f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5ef2491e6f03ebbfd0554acabcdc70a7cd143b29.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/1b5b8a95ad2df769f4a1593727544642fe2b1c05.jpg[/img]

There is a “Purifying Tree” located by the road in the middle of the battlefield that can greatly help your allies advance; players must be careful not to let it be taken by the enemy faction. The key to victory is to adapt a unified yet swift attack tactic through forming a raid party and appointing a leader who will lead the faction. 

[h1]Purifying Tree (Middle Road)[/h1]
[list]
    [*]If players succeed in taking over the tree, a vindictive spirit that attacks the enemy’s military headquarters will be released.
    [*]As the vindictive spirit is unstoppable while it charges towards the fortress gates, players should be swift to claim the Purifying Tree for their faction or risk having the vindictive spirit arrive at their own base.
    [*]The vindictive spirit will soon head for the faction commander once the fortress gates fall.
[/list]
[h1]Guardian Stone (Left and right paths)[/h1]
[list]
    [*]If either faction claims the Purifying Tree and seizes the vindictive spirit, then a Guardian Stone will appear on either the left or right path.
    [*]If players manage to completely deplete the Guardian Stone HP, the vindictive spirit controlled by the enemy faction will disappear. 
    [*]The faction that failed to claim the Purifying Tree before their enemies must decide whether they will directly eliminate the vindictive spirit themselves, or if they will do so through the Guardian Stone. 
[/list]
[h1]Defensive Equipment (Faction Military Headquarters)[/h1]
[list]
    [*]There are 4 mobile artillery located in front of the gates of each faction’s military headquarters to help fend off invading enemies. 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/0e01d67eaa3b3b98abc232544ac6cc7752af1953.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/7519da78943a84dc65e1dd88ca166d3bcaaeac4e.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/24ed17d573e78b0699177929e07d027d766238f0.jpg[/img]

Rankings in the Siege of Castra are determined by activity points, though players can also earn medals by completing achievements. The final reward will be determined by the activity point score and medals earned.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ad9bce7993139f301dac1b850e8a16c948cd52b9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Reward for playing the Siege of Castra once[/h1]
[list]
    [*]If victory is achieved (the player's faction successfully eliminated the enemy commander): Maximum of 400 Combat Points, 100 Quest Performance Points 
    [*] If it ends in a tie (Neither faction was able to defeat the opposing faction’s commander before time ran out): Maximum of 200 Combat Points, 75 Quest Performance Points
    [*]If defeated: Maximum of 150 Combat Points, 35 Quest Performance Points
[/list]
[h1]Siege of Castra Quest Completion Reward[/h1]
[list]
    [*]700 Combat Points, 30 Crystallized Magical Power
[/list]

More details regarding the Siege of Castra and its update schedule will be announced in a later patch note. The Siege of Castra will soon be available! 

Who will lead their faction to victory? 
Start preparing now!

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Notice] Update on duplication bug issue
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

We have taken additional actions regarding the duplication bug since the first announcement was made. After monitoring the situation for some time, we’re now able to confirm that the duplication bug is completely fixed.

[b][Technical measure][/b]
We were able to identify an issue where, while under heavy server loads, timeouts would occur while using the Market. We have implemented a varied approach when resolving this issue. Steps have been taken to minimize the frequency of timeouts while using the Market, and additional checks have also been added to each transaction to verify that a transaction is only being processed once.

Since implementing this fix, we have not seen a recurrence of the duplication bug on the Market. We will also continue to monitor the Market activities for any further signs of bug abuse.

[b][Additional actions][/b]
We have taken action against the accounts of players that have abused this bug and retrieved all of the duplicated items. In case the items had been already used, the equivalent gold amount of these acquired items have been removed instead. Players have also been banned and / or warned due to their actions.

Neowiz and the Bless Online team take exploits very seriously and strive to maintain a level playing field for all players.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Founder's Pack Purchasers May Have Their Items Re-Provided
notes.content:
Greetings!

During the initial stages of service, due to limitations such as restricted server character creation or server locks, many players had to play on a different server from their friends or guildmates.

Since then we have received requests through various channels from players asking for their items to be moved to another server. [u]In consideration of the issue, we will be providing some of the Founder’s Pack items (that players would already have gotten from the specific Founder’s Pack that they already had) to those who purchased Founder’s Packs between 5/28 at 10 AM PDT and 6/8 at 12 AM PDT. [/u]Those who have refunded their Founder’s Pack will not be eligible.
(Premium Membership buffs and Lumena will not be provided.)

Founder’s Pack item addition services will begin on June 11 (PDT) and be completed in the order that purchases were made. After this, there will be NO MORE opportunities to ask for the restoration or server transfer of Founder’s Packs or Founder’s Pack items. Therefore, please carefully select the character and server that you want to receive your items on.

[h1] [Details][/h1] 
*  To be  eligible, players must have purchased a Founder’s Pack between the following dates and time: [b]5/28 10:00 - 6/8 00:00 (PDT)[/b] 

[b]* Who is Eligible?[/b]
[list]
[*]Those who purchased one of the following
[*]Standard Edition - Founder's Pack
[*]Deluxe Edition - Founder's Pack
[*]Collector's Edition - Founder's Pack
[*]Deluxe Edition Upgrade DLC
[*]Collector’s Edition Upgrade DLC
[/list]

[b] * How to Claim Your Founder’s Pack[/b] 
[list]
[*]Based on your purchase record, some items of the same Founder’s Pack will be additionally provided. (Premium Membership buffs and Lumena will not be provided.)
[*]Premium Buffs are not provided as they are commonly applied on a per-region basis.
[*]Although Lumena will not be provided this time, we will be looking into ways to allow our players to transfer Lumena to another server. Before implementation, we will inform all our users in advance once we settle on the specifics. 
[*]If you purchased various Founder’s Packs on one account, you will receive one of each appropriate item once.[/list]

[b]* Date Items will be provided to you AUTOMATICALLY[/b]
[list]
[*]Items will be sent to players’ account inboxes from 6/11 to 6/15 (PDT) in consecutive order of purchases made.
[/list]
We hope that this will address some of the concerns you voiced to us, and we will continue to listen to user feedback in order to provide better service.

Thank you.
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Notice] Game Balance Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/06a85eaa43fafba6bc0095cd330c927ea0797cc7.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

The balance patch (v1.0.0.8) that our dev team promised is currently in the final stages of QA. Thank you all for your patience. We plan to implement the update as soon as all QA processes are complete. We hope that our players will try out this patch and provide us with feedback. More information and the exact patch dates will be announced in the next post.  


[h1][b]v1.0.0.8 Patch Description[/b][/h1]
[olist]
    [*]Reduced the defense ability (HP or defense) of field monsters and low level dungeons.
    [*]Increased Chain Bonus
    [*]Adjusted some classes’ skill effects
[/olist]
Please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/681660/announcements/detail/1653264683503492995][u]patch note for more details. (v1.0.0.8 Patch Note)[/u][/url]



[h1][b]Future Update Plan[/b][/h1]
[olist]
    [*][b]Ranger Balance Patch[/b]
We will be applying patch v1.0.0.8, which reduces the Ranger’s utilities’ cooldown time. We are also aware that there are additional issues, and we plan to fix these in an additional patch as adjusting the Ranger class is a high priority right now. 

    [*][b]Other Classes’ Balance Patches[/b]
Balance modifications will not end with just this patch. We plan to continue with other class balances in stages. 

    [*][b]Patch regarding the conditions that cuts off the Chain Bonus[/b]
The Chain Bonus cuts off in the following situations:
[table]
[tr]
	[th]NOW[/th]
	[th]AFTER CHAIN BONUS PATCH[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]miss, dodge, resist, immune[/td]
	[td]miss[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

The higher the hit rating, the less “misses” there will be. As this is dependent on the player, the current rule will not be modified. However, as dodge, resist, and immune are defenses on the side of the enemy, they will no longer break Chain Bonuses as there is nothing you can do attack-wise that will prevent the chain from breaking. This patch will soon be applied. 

    [*][b]Action Targeting Mode[/b]
Lastly, I present to you our plans for the action targeting mode. During the development process, we found that we cannot guarantee optimal control of the action targeting mode for all classes, except for the Berserker. We plan to make it possible for other classes to use action targeting as soon as we solve these gameplay problems (except for the Paladin class which will only have tab-targeting). However, this adjustment is currently pushed back as we are focusing on stabilization and balance. We will provide you with more information once we have determined a time frame for the action targeting mode update. 
[/olist]

We really appreciate the quick and clear feedback we have been getting from the community; we always want to address issues players find as quickly and effectively as possible. Please continue to share your thoughts and ideas with us! With your help we will do our best to quickly find the best direction for Bless Online. 

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Notice] We Heard Your Game Balance Feedback!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/06a85eaa43fafba6bc0095cd330c927ea0797cc7.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

We understand the community’s complaints after the v.1.0.0.4 game balance adjustment. First of all, we’d like to apologize for not providing you proper game balance with the patch. We are gathering your feedback and play data in order to achieve optimal game balance.

[h1]Balancing Purpose[/h1]
[olist]
[*]First of all, the Steam version of Bless Online’s core combat element is the Chain system and its Chain Bonus. [u]Chained skills are designed to give you more returns (damage) when you successfully connect combo chains and less returns when you fail to connect the combo chains[/u]. We want to encourage our players to utilize the full potential of the Chain system in their play. 
[*]Secondly, our game balance goal is to [u]bind players together for our end-game content. In addition, we want the end-game to be challenging[/u]. However, we understand low-level and solo players’ difficulties and we will make up for it soon. 
[/olist]

[h1]Future Balance directions...[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Decreasing ability (HP or defense) of monsters from the field and low-level dungeons. Adjustments will be determined by leveling area and monster level. 
[*]Increasing Chain Bonus values. The more skills you connect, the higher the damage you will do. This will make up for the decreased DPS. 

[u]We are currently working on #1 and #2 over the weekend and we are expecting to update the game with a patch [b]by early next week[/b]. [/u]We have a lot of things to do, but game balance follow-up and server stabilization are our top priorities. 

[*]Direct DPS increase adjustment.
[*]Skill cooldown and resource adjustment.

[u]After next week, we will be working on #3 and #4 with caution because they will have a direct effect on both PvE and PvP balance. [/u]
[/olist]

[h1] Early Access players...[/h1]
We are very grateful to those who play Bless Online even though there have been setbacks. We hope you to try our next game balance patch and give us your feedback. The developers will be testing game balance even after making the changes listed above based on your feedback and play data. We’ll be updating the game regularly with new features, balances, and tweaks based on what we’re hearing from you.

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Notice] Game Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
Greetings!

The character’s stat balance problem which we’ve announced recently are now going to be applied through todays patch. 

Before today’s patch, character’s stats were set differently from what we intended. For that reason, we found out that only a few set of skills have been used in most classes. The offensive skills values were set too high while the defensive/healing skills’ value were set too low. 

Due to this, players would have felt that monsters were too easy to defeat. Also ranged dealers were too powerful while healers and tankers were unable to use their full ability in PvP related content. 

After this balance patch, players will be able to enjoy dungeons, battlefields, raids, PvP, RvR content at the intended difficulty. Our developers will be closely monitoring our players’ game data, and based on your feedback we will do our best to maintain ideal game balanced.

Details regarding balance modifications are as follows.


[h1][b] Balance Adjustments per Class [/b][/h1]
Almost all skills’ damage were decreased while all class’ HP was increased.

Every class’ dodge skills are now “rechargeable skills” and for some classes, their necessary (e.g. Bravery, Anger etc.) resources were removed.[quote]
    [*][b]Paladin[/b]
[list]
    [*]Almost all skills’ damage decreased.
    [*]Health Point (HP) increased.
    [*]Most of the Paladin’s healing skills have been strengthened. 
    [*]Most of the Paladin’s offensive skills’ mana consumption is reduced. 
    [*]The “Endure” skill is now recharged up to 3 times instead of once.
[/list]

    [*][b]Guardian[/b]
[list]
    [*]Almost all skills’ damage decreased.
    [*]Health Point (HP) increased.
    [*]The “Guardian’s Faith” skill is now rechargeable up to 3 times instead of once, and no longer consumes “Bravery”.
[/list]

    [*][b]Berserker[/b]
[list]
    [*]Almost all skills’ damage decreased.
    [*]Health Point (HP) increased.
    [*]“Dodge Move” is now rechargeable up to 5 times instead of once, and no longer consumes “Anger”.
[/list]

    [*][b]Ranger[/b]
[list]
    [*]Almost all skills’ damage decreased.
    [*]Health Point (HP) increased.
    [*]“Dodge Move” is now rechargeable up to 3 times instead of once.
[/list]

    [*][b]Mage[/b]
[list]
   [*]Almost all skills’ damage decreased.
   [*]Health Point (HP) increased.
   [*]“Blink” is now rechargeable up to 3 times (4 if enhanced) instead of once.
[/list]

[/quote]


[h1][b]Chain Bonus Balance[/b][/h1]
Chain Bonus refers to the effect where the skill’s effect increases the higher the chain stage is.

The chain bonus was generally set too high, and could not even be applied over 7 chains. Through today’s patch the overall chain bonus was reduced and the problem where it is not applied beyond 7 chains was resolved.


[h1][b]Skill Reset Scroll Price Reduction[/b][/h1] 
Through today’s patch, players can purchase the Skill Reset Scroll (Up to 3 per character) from the Special Currency Shop for only 1 Lumena for a limited time period. The Skill Reset Scroll will allow players to try out various new tactics and explore their skill options. 
[list]
    [*]For Lumena, you can exchange Activity Points (Combat and Dungeon Points) into Lumena up to 50 Lumena a day. 
    [*]Skill Reset Scroll (Price: 1 Lumena) will be separately added in the Special Currency Shop.
    [*]Until our next scheduled maintenance on June 8, the price will continue to be 1 Lumena. However the scheduled maintenance date is subject to change. 
[/list]

[h1][b]We seek your feedback![/b][/h1] 
We are open to your feedback regarding today’s patch and overall game balance! Throughout Early Access we will continue to closely monitor game balance and will do our best to respond to user feedback. 
 

Thank You,
The Bless Team

notes.title: EA Update Preview #1 - New BattleField : Peninsular War
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/1cf1e04f0fe803aaf4119391f7e7539c9dfcc1fa.jpg[/img]

Greetings!

It is my pleasure to introduce to you our small-scale RvR content “Peninsular War”, which will be introduced to Bless Online today.  

The Peninsular War is a small battlefield located by the beautiful tropical southern peninsula. A total of 30 players (15 from each Hieron and Union) may join the Peninsular War, which was created so that players can experience the fun of battlefield combat with elaborate strategies and a small amount of players. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4b9d38bca3f05645064a6823cac7694907a37cee.jpg[/img]

If you want to try out the Peninsular War go to [u]Menu(Esc)>War(b)>Battlefield List then Peninsula War[/u]. Once both faction’s team matching is complete you will be able to enter the battlefield. There will be 2-3 minutes of waiting time before the battle officially begins. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/18769daf13c18926def28a7b97284ce4b35b57e8.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/55e9308d5e193fe943e29c147499e2a748ca85eb.jpg[/img]

The basic rules are simple. On the battlefield there are 4 bases and 1 special base. Points are earned every time players capture a base. Although acquiring points is important, deciding on which base to capture is also as critical to victory as your character will resurrect at the nearest base. 

The faction that acquires 20,000 points first within the 15-25 time limit wins, but if time runs out before either side reaches 20,000 points, victory is awarded to the side with more points. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/052f810705f9977be7b1fadac1796fbbfc1dda34.jpg[/img]

Although the Peninsular War is comparably small-scaled battlefield, there are many topographical features that can be used strategically. If you want to win, you need to decide on whether your team is going to split up and attack multiple bases all at once, or if you are going to band together and target a specific base. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/7f3b00ba5e1fbe7374c4770d34155cae61db93f3.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4ea36b7b4e135dee04ef92705fcee8a94db00194.jpg[/img]

However, as we understand that it can be boring to always play with the same rules. Therefore we came up with ways to prevent our players from being tired of Peninsular War. Although the core rules will be the same, there may be different rules per week, and topographical features such as poison swamps and sky bridges depending on the season level rotation system. Victory will be decided by how well players make use of them to win. 

[h1] Season Level Rotation System [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Season 1: Useful items will be scattered around the battlefield.
    [*]Season 2: There will be neutral mobs that you can “turn into allies” around the battlefield
    [*]Season 3: A sky bridge that allows players to quickly get to important bases 
    [*]Season 4: The mana consumption and cooltime of all skills used will be reduced. 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5b2521e394c69bb9ed7e68e28cf42636ae514fa1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ba6e4be70c836f5e34db45d46260888999dab5bf.jpg[/img]

Combat Points are awarded to all participants of the Peninsular War regardless of whether their faction won or lost. Additional rewards can be acquired by completing daily quests (once per day).

[h1] Rewards [/h1][list]
[*] Victory: 700 Combat Points
[*] Defeat: 100 Combat Points
[*] Completes Peninsular War’s Daily Quest: 300 Combat Points
[list]
[*]Successfully carries out the Quest: 75 Participation Points
[*]Fails the Quest: 35 Participation Points
[/list]
[/list]※ Players can use combat points to purchase useful items at the Special Currency Shop.


We hope you will enjoy a unique battlefield in Bless Online every week!

Thank You,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Notice] Duplication bug issue

We were able to identify the cause of the duplication bug while investigating it as our highest priority, and are taking action to resolve the issues caused.

Action details:
We will collect all the items/gold earned from this duplication bug.
If the duplication bug was used less than 10 times, we will issue a ‘Warning’.
If the duplication bug was used more than 10 times, we will block their accounts for three days.
If the duplication bug was used more than 10 times and considered to be deliberate, we will block their accounts for 15 days.

Action will take place on May 31st and the characters may be temporarily restricted during the item/gold collect process.

We expect to see a lot of bugs during our Early Access and we will do our best to fix them. Please report any bugs to the Bless Team and please do not to abuse them!

Thank you,
The Bless Team
